jobs.title: Tech Lead (C# .NET - SaaS & Low-Code), €5.500 - €7.000 | Zoetermeer
jobs.description:
Ben jij een ervaren ontwikkelaar en leider die graag de technische richting bepaalt én zelf aan de knoppen zit? Als Tech Lead bouw jij samen met het team van ontwikkelaars aan schaalbare cloudoplossingen waarmee dagelijks honderden organisaties slimmer en efficiënter werken. Jij bent een technisch zwaargewicht die de kwaliteit, performance en toekomstbestendigheid van onze moderne SaaS-architectuur bewaakt. Je gaat over de technische beslissingen rondom ons eigen low-code platform en bent dé kartrekker van de groep. Jouw keuzes hebben directe impact op techniek, product én de toekomst van digitale documentverwerking.

Jij maakt het mogelijk

Onze groei vraagt om robuuste, veilige en altijd beschikbare services. Als Tech Lead merk je direct waar risico’s ontstaan: complexiteit loopt op, schaalbaarheid komt in gevaar en technische schuld vraagt om leiderschap. Jij stuurt bij vóórdat klanten het merken. Met moderne cloud-technologie, duurzame oplossingen en hoge codekwaliteit maak jij samen met het team het verschil, niet alleen vandaag, maar juist voor de toekomst.

Je kijkt verder vooruit dan de volgende release en je durft jezelf en het team uit te dagen. Daarnaast coach je de ontwikkelaars uit het team technisch en neem je initiatief om onze producten verder te brengen. Je bent de kartrekker van de groep, en schakelt laagdrempelig met onze product owners, engineering manager en andere development teams.

Concreet betekent dit dat jij:

+ Leiding neemt over het low-code platform ontwikkelteam;

+ Samen met dit team ontwikkelt aan ons low-code platform, op basis van wensen vanuit de operatie én technische eisen voor future-proofing;

+ Als senior de codekwaliteit verhoogt door coaching, code-reviews en kennisdeling;

+ Actief meebouwt aan architectuurkeuzes, coding standards en automatisering in uitrol;

+ Kwaliteit borgt via tests, monitoring en goede documentatie;

+ Continu zoekt naar verbeteringen m.b.t. schaalbaarheid, stabiliteit, performance, security;

+ Samen met collega’s zoals ontwikkelaars, product owners en engineering managers spart over oplossingsrichtingen;

+ Wanneer nodig onze collega’s van consultancy en support helpt om complexe problemen met ons low-code platform op te lossen;

+ Verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor een aantal bestaande maatwerkprojecten en indien nodig niet terugdeinst voor een nieuwe maatwerk opdracht.

Hoe jouw werkweek eruitziet

Op maandag spar je met de teamleden en zorg je ervoor dat iedereen weet waar ze aan moeten werken, en dat ze daar ook verder mee kunnen. Je pakt zelf een wijziging op die vraagt om een nieuwe schaalbare service en je denkt direct mee over architectuur en security-impact. Later in de week review je code van collega’s en help je een medior op weg met een complexe async-workflow. Je overlegt met onze product owners en engineering manager en zorgt ervoor dat het team op één lijn zitten en weten wat er speelt. Tussendoor onderzoek je nieuwe technische mogelijkheden en voer je verbeteringen door waarmee klanten nóg fijner met onze software kunnen werken. Je werkt hybride en vindt zo de ideale balans tussen focus en samenwerking.

"Bij Whitevision hebben we meer dan 20 jaar aan rijke software-ontwikkeling achter ons liggen. Wat begon als een flexibele oplossing, is uitgegroeid tot een essentieel platform met integraties in diverse ERP-systemen. Onze groei van de afgelopen jaren laat zich onder andere zien in de ontwikkeling van een moderne React-frontend en de start van migraties naar Azure Functions, die we verder willen doorontwikkelen. Daarnaast richten we ons op onderhoudbaarheid, internationalisering en integraties met nieuwe bedrijven zoals Inconto. Ons platform, gebouwd in C#.NET, wordt continu doorontwikkeld door een groeiend team. Als Tech Lead krijg je de kans om niet alleen het technische hart van ons product verder vorm te geven, maar ook strategisch mee te denken over de toekomst van ons platform en onze producten. Met jouw visie en leiderschap help je onze software klaar te maken voor de volgende 20 jaar." - Serge Settels (Lead Software Developer).



Jij hebt het

+ Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als Back-end Developer, waarvan een deel in een Lead of minstens Senior rol;

+ Coaching-ervaring en de drive om technisch leiderschap te tonen;

+ Uitgebreide kennis van C#, .NET (Core), Databases en REST API’s;

+ Ervaring met complexe SaaS-architecturen;

+ Ervaring met MS SQL Databases, en performance tuning/troubleshooting op DB niveau;

+ Kennis van infrastructuur-principes en voldoende begrip van front-end aspecten om goed samen te werken en te beoordelen;

+ Ervaring met FluentMigrator, Aspose, en algemene testautomatisering is een pré;

+ Ervaring met low-code is een pré.

Ook breng je mee:

+ Analytisch vermogen: je doorgrondt complexe datastromen en neemt onderbouwde besluiten voor schaalbaarheid en security;

+ Communicatieve samenwerking: je zorgt voor een sterke verbinding binnen het multidisciplinaire team;

+ Eigenaarschap: je houdt overzicht, anticipeert op risico’s en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor het eindresultaat;

+ Een proactieve houding: je neemt initiatief, en zorgt ervoor dat benodigde informatie actief opgehaald wordt zodat projecten vlot doorlopen.


Onze Whitevision manier van werken is met respect, daadkracht, betrokkenheid en ambitie.

Deze kernwaarden passen dan ook uitstekend bij jouw persoonlijkheid.



Dit verdien jij
+ Een salaris waar je blij van wordt, €5.500 - €7.000 o.b.v. 40 uur, 8% vakantiegeld, 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om 5 extra dagen te kopen (o.b.v. 40 uur) en flexibele werktijden.

+ Een mooi kantoor in Zoetermeer. We bieden ook de mogelijkheid om ook twee dagen per week thuis te werken, maar veel van onze collega’s vinden het zo leuk om op kantoor te werken dat zij dit minimaal doen.

+ Wij investeren graag in de groei en ontwikkeling van onze collega’s door middel van training of opleiding.

+ Een gezellig team met kantoren in Zoetermeer, de Goorn, Rotterdam en Breda. We werken hard, maar lachen minstens zo veel met elkaar!

+ Onderdeel worden van een snelgroeiend SaaS-bedrijf in Breda met de missie om repeterend werk de wereld uit te helpen.

Kortom, wil je meer strategisch adviseren, collega’s coachen en écht impact maken binnen een snelgroeiende internationale SaaS-organisatie? Dan maken wij graag kennis met je.

Jouw rol
Als Senior Implementatie Consultant word je verantwoordelijk voor meerdere implementaties bij verschillende organisaties, met een diversiteit aan Whitevision producten. Jij bent het aanspreekpunt en de trusted advisor voor jouw klanten. Je bepaalt grotendeels zelf, in overleg met de klant, waar je je werkzaamheden uitvoert. Je analyseert klantprocessen, denkt strategisch mee over de beste inrichting en begeleidt organisaties servicegericht naar een succesvolle livegang.

Je werkt zelfstandig, deelt je kennis met het team en coacht startende consultants. Je signaleert commerciële kansen bij bestaande klanten en draagt bij aan standaardisatie en verbetering van onze consultancyprocessen, die het team als geheel beter maken bijvoorbeeld door het inzetten van AI gedreven functionaliteit. Tegelijk blijf je jezelf ontwikkelen: je vergroot je productkennis, houdt je vakkennis bij en krijgt de ruimte om door te groeien richting een leidinggevende, coachende of expertrol binnen onze consultancyorganisatie. Je taken en verantwoordelijkheden zijn:
+ Je leidt end to end de implementatietrajecten.
+ Je analyseert documentprocessen en vertaalt deze naar slimme, schaalbare oplossingen.
+ Je adviseert klanten op operationeel én managementniveau.
+ Je traint eindgebruikers en zorgt voor maximale adoptie van onze software.
+ Je bewaakt planning, kwaliteit en klanttevredenheid binnen je projecten.
+ Je coacht junior en medior consultants en deelt actief je kennis.


Wat breng je mee?
+ Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde Hbo, bijvoorbeeld richting BIM, Bedrijfskunde of bedrijfseconomie.
+ Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het uitvoeren van software-implementaties.
+ Je hebt al ervaring met projectleiding en stakeholdermanagement.
+ Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden (Nederlands én Engels).
+ Analytisch, resultaatgericht en commercieel bewust.
+ Ervaring met SaaS-oplossingen, SQL, ERP en affiniteit met documentverwerking is een pré.
+ Een coachende instelling: je vindt het leuk om collega’s verder te helpen.
+ Je bent minimaal 32 uur per week beschikbaar (onze voorkeur gaat uit naar 40 uur).


Jij bent de consultant waar klanten om vragen en waar collega’s van leren.
Bij Whitevision krijg je de ruimte, het vertrouwen en de schaal van een groeiende Europese groep om écht impact te maken.


Wat bieden wij?
Naast het werken binnen een gezellig, gemotiveerd en betrokken team bieden wij jou:
+ Een salaris tussen €4.250 en €6.000 (o.b.v. 40 uur), afhankelijk van je opleiding en ervaring.
+ Een auto van de zaak, laptop, mobiele telefoon en pensioenregeling.
+ 25 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om 5 extra dagen te kopen (o.b.v. 40 uur).
+ Een inspirerende werkomgeving met flexibiliteit in locatie/werkplek (hybride) en werktijden.
+ Verantwoordelijkheid en zelfstandigheid in je rol, met invloed op onze diensten en strategie.
+ Een professioneel en hardwerkend team,  waar samenwerken en ontspanning samen gaan.
+ Een informele organisatie waar we regelmatig uitjes organiseren met het team en bedrijf

Over Whitevision
Whitevision is een toonaangevende SaaS-speler in Intelligent Document Processing & Management, die meer dan 2300 organisaties helpt hun documentprocessen slimmer, sneller en betrouwbaarder te maken. Wij ontwikkelen slimme, schaalbare en betrouwbare tools voor factuurverwerking, procurement, spend en document management, die naadloos integreren met een breed scala aan ERP-systemen.

Vandaag de dag vertrouwen onze klanten op onze oplossingen. Vanuit kantoren in Breda, Rotterdam, Zoetermeer, De Goorn, Milton Keynes en Southampton werken ruim 140 medewerkers aan de doorontwikkeling en toepassing ervan, in een cultuur gebouwd op de kernwaarden betrokken, ambitieus, respectvol en daadkrachtig.

Als Senior Implementatie Consultant speel je een sleutelrol: jij zorgt ervoor dat onze klanten succesvol live gaan én tevreden blijven. Je werkt nauw samen met 45 gedreven collega’s in het Support & Consultancy team. In een omgeving waar je je productkennis verder verdiept en je expertise volop kunt inzetten en uitbouwen.

Doorgroeimogelijkheden

Binnen Whitevision krijg je de ruimte om door te groeien naar rollen met meer strategische, organisatorische en internationale impact. Afhankelijk van jouw ambities kun je je ontwikkelen richting meer inhoudelijke diepgang (solution expert) of juist breder leiderschap als Lead of Manager binnen onze snelgroeiende internationale organisatie.

jobs.title: (Senior) Full Stack Engineer (m/f/x) - Based in Germany
jobs.description:
Cara Care, a digital health company backed by Bayer AG, is on a mission to improve people’s digestive health through technology. As we expand our product portfolio and modernize our platform, we’re looking for a versatile, pragmatic, and forward-thinking (Senior) Full-Stack Engineer (m/f/x) to help shape the future of digital therapeutics.

Your Role

You’ll join a cross-functional product team with high ownership, lean processes, and a clear focus: deliver real impact to patients. We’re looking for someone who thrives on solving real-world problems with code, is technology-open, and knows when to build fast and when to build right. Your main focus will be building and improving our backend services, while also contributing to our React Native apps.  You’ll also help us use AI tools and coding agents thoughtfully in day-to-day engineering, turning emerging capabilities into reliable workflows that improve how we design, build, test, and operate patient-facing products.

Your Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and operate reliable backend services and APIs, primarily using Python, Django, and PostgreSQL, and contribute targeted changes to our React Native applications with TypeScript.
  • Use AI coding agents to implement features, refactor code, and generate tests. Define clear tasks and constraints, provide relevant context, Provide clear context and constraints, and validate changes through code review, automated tests, and application-level checks.
  • Take an end-to-end view of features: understand how mobile clients, APIs, data models, and infrastructure interact, and make pragmatic technical decisions across these boundaries.
  • Own backend delivery from architecture and implementation to automated testing, deployment, monitoring, and iteration, and continuously improve our CI/CD pipelines.
  • Improve the performance and reliability of our backend services, APIs, and databases.
  • Connect AI-assisted development to engineering and design tools via MCP, for example to automate repetitive coding tasks or check frontend changes against Figma designs. Keep patient data, credentials, and other sensitive information out of unapproved tools and workflows.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Medical to explore, define, and deliver patient-centric features across our platform, supporting regulated digital health products for IBS, GERD, and upcoming indications.
  • Uphold technical excellence in architecture, code quality, and security, including applicable requirements under IEC 62304, BSI TR-03161, and the MDR. 
  • Mentor other developers and help raise the technical bar across the team.

Requirements

Your Profile

Must haves

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong backend focus and an understanding of how complete applications work from user interface to infrastructure.
  • Strong backend development skills in an established language such as Python, TypeScript, Java, or PHP. Our current stack includes Python, Django, and PostgreSQL.
  • Working knowledge of React Native and TypeScript, with the ability to implement and test changes in an existing mobile application.
  • Solid understanding of relational databases, API design, distributed systems and services.
  • Experience writing and maintaining automated tests for backend services and APIs, including unit and integration tests.
  • Solid understanding of backend security and privacy, including authentication, authorization, secrets management, and secure handling of personal and patient data.
  • Strong practical knowledge of containers, Kubernetes, and cloud-native architecture, with experience using GCP or another major cloud provider such as AWS or Azure.
  • Hands-on experience using AI coding agents to implement features, refactor code, and write automated tests, including connecting agents to engineering tools via MCP. You can explain how you scoped the work, verified the results, and handled tool permissions and sensitive data.
  • A pragmatic product mindset: you collaborate effectively with non-technical stakeholders, understand the impact of technical decisions on patients and UX, and continuously improve both product and platform.

Nice-to-have

  • Strong Linux administration skills, including setting up, operating, and securing self-managed cloud instances; familiarity with monitoring and observability concepts.
  • Experience with Prometheus, Loki, and Grafana; GitOps using ArgoCD or FluxCD; or configuration management using Ansible or similar tools.
  • Networking knowledge and experience with mobile CI/CD, release automation, or application monitoring tools such as Sentry.
  • Experience in regulated industries, healthcare, or other security-conscious environments.


💡Please note: Cara Care is a remote-first company with a fully distributed team. All team members are based in Germany so candidates must reside in Germany to join us.

Benefits

💸 Fair compensation: We offer fair pay, regular salary reviews, and the equipment you need to do your best work.

🫶 Great team spirit: Join a vibrant, interdisciplinary team and enjoy a friendly, supportive working atmosphere, with regular in-person team events.

👨‍💻 Remote-first working: Prefer working from home? No problem. Want to join us at our Berlin office? That works too. Our remote-first approach gives you the flexibility to work where it suits you best.

🏝️ 30 days off per year: Rest matters. You’ll get 26 vacation days plus 4 additional company-wide mental health days each year to take a breather and recharge.

🦉 Flexible working hours: Whether you’re an early bird or prefer a later start, you can shape your working day around what works for you.

🏋️ Urban Sports Club (USC): Enjoy access to a wide range of sports, fitness, and wellness activities at discounted rates.

🧠 OpenUp: Access a variety of resources and services to support your mental health and personal wellbeing.

🛍️ Corporate Benefits: Get attractive discounts and exclusive offers from a wide range of well-known brands and providers.

🚀 Make a real impact: Be involved, contribute your ideas, and help shape what comes next. Your voice matters, and you can make a real difference.

About Cara Care

Cara Care is a digital health company on a mission to improve the lives of people with digestive health conditions through holistic, science-based digital therapies.

Our established IBS therapy, Cara Care für Reizdarm, provides personalised content, practical exercises, and symptom tracking to help people better understand and manage their condition. It is listed in the German Federal Institute for Drugs and Medical Devices’ (BfArM) directory of digital health applications (DiGA) and is covered by statutory health insurance in Germany.

We are expanding our product portfolio and evolving our technology platform to bring digital therapies to more people across a broader range of conditions.

Backed by Bayer

We’re proud to share that Cara Care has recently joined the Bayer Group, a move that strengthens our mission and enables us to scale our impact even further. With Bayer’s global healthcare expertise and our innovative digital approach, we’re poised to redefine care for digestive health.

What It’s Like to Work With Us

At Cara Care, you’ll be part of an interdisciplinary team of doctors, designers, engineers, and creatives who are deeply passionate about improving lives. We’re inspired by our patients and driven by real-world impact. We move fast, collaborate closely, and never lose sight of the importance of well-being—both for our users and ourselves.

Diversity Matters to Us

We believe that diverse teams build better products. That’s why we’re committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone—regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, or disability.

We know that applying for a new job is a big step, and we genuinely appreciate your time and effort. We’re excited to get to know you!

- Collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders, including Biometry, Clinical Operations, Medical teams, and external partners.

- Ensure complete and accurate maintenance of study documentation, including accountability for eTMF completion.

Requirements

At Excelya, we encourage everyone to be bold, challenge themselves, and unlock their full potential. We are looking for professionals who share our values and are eager to grow in a dynamic and stimulating environment.

Master’s degree in Statistics, Biostatistics, Epidemiology, or a related scientific discipline.

Experience :
Very strong experience in statistics and statistical programming within the pharmaceutical, biotech, or healthcare industry, including significant exposure to Real-World Evidence (RWE), non-interventional studies, and Secondary Use of Data (SUD) projects

Skills : Hands-on experience with SAS programming and statistical validation. Experience with R and/or large healthcare databases (claims databases, EHR/EMR, registries) is considered a strong asset. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a cross-functional and international environment.

Languages : Fluent English, both written and spoken.

Why join us?

jobs.title: Lead Database Administrator
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

Why Join Us

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

Job Overview

We are at a pivotal point in our tech progression. We're looking to grow our technical estate, architect new systems, remove technical debt and scale our platform. It's an exciting time to join Partnerize, and we are looking for a technical leader to help spearhead this evolution.

As a database engineer, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy, acting as the principal technical authority and taking end-to-end ownership of our database estate. You will be a strategic anchor within the Technical Operations team, interfacing directly with business, development, and IT functions. While you will own the database architecture and design solutions for the future, a fundamental, non-negotiable part of this role is hands-on Business As Usual incident management. You must be comfortable rolling up your sleeves to handle daily operations, backups, and performance tuning alongside project delivery.

Your deep expertise in MySQL, alongside strong Linux system administration and a working knowledge of network troubleshooting, will be critical to your success. You will design, build, and secure the underlying servers our databases run on, proactively analyse current implementations, and act as the ultimate technical escalation point for our database infrastructure in both our physical datacenters as well as our public cloud estate.

While we need your advanced technical skills, we are equally focused on character. We are looking for a highly proactive communicator who collaborates seamlessly without needing to be prompted. Crucially, you must be able to independently plan out complex technical work, such as database upgrades, and clearly articulate the step-by-step process and business impacts to stakeholders. You must thrive both when working independently to tackle complex problems and when operating collaboratively within a broader team. Furthermore, you will actively seek out opportunities to coach and mentor other engineers, elevating the overall DBA knowledge across the company. This role is fully remote and open to candidates based anywhere in the UK or the US.

As a Database Engineer at Partnerize, You Will:

  • Primary Operational Ownership: Take complete, hands-on ownership of daily database operations. Managing and maintaining the database infrastructure for day-to-day use, including backup management, resolving slow-running queries, and performance tuning, is a fundamental pillar of this role.
  • Infrastructure & Server Support: Be comfortable in providing operational support by designing, securing, and robustly maintaining the underlying Linux servers that our large distributed databases run on.
  • Project Planning & Stakeholder Communication: Plan, manage, and deliver large technical projects like database upgrades and migrations. You will autonomously map out step-by-step execution plans, proactively communicate technical considerations, and clearly articulate the business impact of your work to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Technical Leadership & Strategy: Scope incoming work, delegate to team members where appropriate, and act as the definitive database escalation point for support teams within the wider organisation.
  • Proactive Optimisation & Automation: Measure and optimise system performance to push our capabilities forward. Lead the automation of management and monitoring for the database platform infrastructure.
  • Collaboration & Documentation: Partner closely with development teams, product owners, and other stakeholders to ensure database needs are met and to improve the testability of database aspects within software deployments. Document procedures, best practices, and troubleshooting steps for knowledge sharing.
  • Delivery & Out-of-Hours/On-Call Support: Plan, prioritise, and estimate tasks using Jira, and provide essential support for any critical database-related issues both during and outside of normal business hours.
  • Mentorship: Actively mentor and coach other engineers, providing technical leadership on database design, optimisation, and migration strategies to elevate overall team knowledge.

Essential Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • MySQL & On-Premise Infrastructure: Advanced administration of MySQL in production environments, whether on-premise or in the cloud. Crucially, as our primary database is on-premise, you must possess strong Linux system administration and networking awareness to independently support, secure, and maintain the underlying servers.
  • Independence: Experience as either the sole or lead owner for large production database infrastructure within a SaaS environment with demonstrable accountability for its availability and performance. A proven track record of managing these responsibilities while coordinating with external technical stakeholders and adhering to light change management processes.
  • High Availability & Replication: Advanced experience configuring and troubleshooting complex MySQL replication setups (such as primary-replica, multi-master, and GTID). Proven ability to quickly resolve replication lag, manage smooth failovers, and execute disaster recovery plans. 
  • Monitoring: A working understanding of database monitoring tools and patterns. What to measure, appropriate thresholds, and response mechanics.
  • Performance Optimisation: Deep expertise in query tuning, slow query analysis, and advanced schema optimisation (including normalisation, partitioning, query rewrites, and indexing strategies).
  • Upgrades, Migrations & Scripting: Proven track record of executing minimal-downtime upgrades and complex migrations (in-place, cross-database, or migrating ancillary workloads). Highly skilled in automating these processes using Python and/or Bash to build robust, version-controlled scripts.
  • Database Security & Compliance: Experience securing database infrastructure through SSL/TLS encryption, user access control, audit logging, and automated backup encryption.

Desirable Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • Automation, Containers & CI/CD: Hands-on expertise using Ansible for configuration management, deploying and managing databases within Kubernetes/containerised environments, and managing version control and pipelines via GitLab for any database related change.
  • Monitoring & Troubleshooting: Hands-on experience deploying and configuring monitoring/alerting stacks (such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Percona Monitoring and Management) for proactive issue resolution and database health tracking.
  • PostgreSQL & Hybrid Estates: Advanced administration of PostgreSQL, alongside experience managing database workloads across a hybrid environment (e.g., combining on-premise architecture with AWS).
  • OLAP & Data Warehousing (Apache Druid / Snowflake): Familiarity with columnar databases and cloud data platforms, particularly Apache Druid and Snowflake. Experience with schema design, data sharding strategies, OLAP query optimisation for long-running queries, and managing zero-downtime upgrades in distributed environments.
  • Service Management Tooling: Experience using Jira and Confluence for managing workflows, project tracking, and creating technical documentation.

Growth & Innovation:

    • Openness to learn the required technologies.
    • An interest in development, new technologies and innovation.
    • Supporting development teams into the refactoring of technical debt.

At Partnerize, we recognise it is unrealistic for a candidate to fulfil 100% of the criteria in this job description. We encourage you to apply if you feel you meet the majority of the requirements above. We know that skills evolve over time, so if you have a keen appetite to learn and evolve alongside us over time, come join our team! 

US Benefits & Perks

  • Flexible Time Off Policy – Take the time you need
  • Enhanced parental leave (16 weeks for birth parent, 8 weeks for non-birth parent at full pay) 
  • Regular company events and activities
  • Robust Company Sponsored Health & Welfare Benefits
  • 401k Plan – 4% employee match
  • Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Fridays program

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization's success. We are at a pivotal point in our tech progression. We're looking to grow our technical estate, architect new systems, remove technical debt and scale our platform. It's an exciting time to join Partnerize, and we are looking for a technical leader to help spearhead this evolution.

As a database engineer, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy, acting as the principal technical authority and taking end-to-end ownership of our database estate. You will be a strategic anchor within the Technical Operations team, interfacing directly with business, development, and IT functions. While you will own the database architecture and design solutions for the future, a fundamental, non-negotiable part of this role is hands-on Business As Usual incident management. You must be comfortable rolling up your sleeves to handle daily operations, backups, and performance tuning alongside project delivery.

Your deep expertise in MySQL, alongside strong Linux system administration and a working knowledge of network troubleshooting, will be critical to your success. You will design, build, and secure the underlying servers our databases run on, proactively analyse current implementations, and act as the ultimate technical escalation point for our database infrastructure in both our physical datacenters as well as our public cloud estate.

While we need your advanced technical skills, we are equally focused on character. We are looking for a highly proactive communicator who collaborates seamlessly without needing to be prompted. Crucially, you must be able to independently plan out complex technical work, such as database upgrades, and clearly articulate the step-by-step process and business impacts to stakeholders. You must thrive both when working independently to tackle complex problems and when operating collaboratively within a broader team. Furthermore, you will actively seek out opportunities to coach and mentor other engineers, elevating the overall DBA knowledge across the company. This role is fully remote and open to candidates based anywhere in the UK or the US.

As a Database Engineer at Partnerize, You Will:

  • Primary Operational Ownership: Take complete, hands-on ownership of daily database operations. Managing and maintaining the database infrastructure for day-to-day use, including backup management, resolving slow-running queries, and performance tuning, is a fundamental pillar of this role.
  • Infrastructure & Server Support: Be comfortable in providing operational support by designing, securing, and robustly maintaining the underlying Linux servers that our large distributed databases run on.
  • Project Planning & Stakeholder Communication: Plan, manage, and deliver large technical projects like database upgrades and migrations. You will autonomously map out step-by-step execution plans, proactively communicate technical considerations, and clearly articulate the business impact of your work to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Technical Leadership & Strategy: Scope incoming work, delegate to team members where appropriate, and act as the definitive database escalation point for support teams within the wider organisation.
  • Proactive Optimisation & Automation: Measure and optimise system performance to push our capabilities forward. Lead the automation of management and monitoring for the database platform infrastructure.
  • Collaboration & Documentation: Partner closely with development teams, product owners, and other stakeholders to ensure database needs are met and to improve the testability of database aspects within software deployments. Document procedures, best practices, and troubleshooting steps for knowledge sharing.
  • Delivery & Out-of-Hours/On-Call Support: Plan, prioritise, and estimate tasks using Jira, and provide essential support for any critical database-related issues both during and outside of normal business hours.
  • Mentorship: Actively mentor and coach other engineers, providing technical leadership on database design, optimisation, and migration strategies to elevate overall team knowledge.

Essential Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • MySQL & On-Premise Infrastructure: Advanced administration of MySQL in production environments, whether on-premise or in the cloud. Crucially, as our primary database is on-premise, you must possess strong Linux system administration and networking awareness to independently support, secure, and maintain the underlying servers.
  • Independence: Experience as either the sole or lead owner for large production database infrastructure within a SaaS environment with demonstrable accountability for its availability and performance. A proven track record of managing these responsibilities while coordinating with external technical stakeholders and adhering to light change management processes.
  • High Availability & Replication: Advanced experience configuring and troubleshooting complex MySQL replication setups (such as primary-replica, multi-master, and GTID). Proven ability to quickly resolve replication lag, manage smooth failovers, and execute disaster recovery plans. 
  • Monitoring: A working understanding of database monitoring tools and patterns. What to measure, appropriate thresholds, and response mechanics.
  • Performance Optimisation: Deep expertise in query tuning, slow query analysis, and advanced schema optimisation (including normalisation, partitioning, query rewrites, and indexing strategies).
  • Upgrades, Migrations & Scripting: Proven track record of executing minimal-downtime upgrades and complex migrations (in-place, cross-database, or migrating ancillary workloads). Highly skilled in automating these processes using Python and/or Bash to build robust, version-controlled scripts.
  • Database Security & Compliance: Experience securing database infrastructure through SSL/TLS encryption, user access control, audit logging, and automated backup encryption.

Desirable Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • Automation, Containers & CI/CD: Hands-on expertise using Ansible for configuration management, deploying and managing databases within Kubernetes/containerised environments, and managing version control and pipelines via GitLab for any database related change.
  • Monitoring & Troubleshooting: Hands-on experience deploying and configuring monitoring/alerting stacks (such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Percona Monitoring and Management) for proactive issue resolution and database health tracking.
  • PostgreSQL & Hybrid Estates: Advanced administration of PostgreSQL, alongside experience managing database workloads across a hybrid environment (e.g., combining on-premise architecture with AWS).
  • OLAP & Data Warehousing (Apache Druid / Snowflake): Familiarity with columnar databases and cloud data platforms, particularly Apache Druid and Snowflake. Experience with schema design, data sharding strategies, OLAP query optimisation for long-running queries, and managing zero-downtime upgrades in distributed environments.
  • Service Management Tooling: Experience using Jira and Confluence for managing workflows, project tracking, and creating technical documentation.

Growth & Innovation:

    • Openness to learn the required technologies.
    • An interest in development, new technologies and innovation.
    • Supporting development teams into the refactoring of technical debt.

At Partnerize, we recognise it is unrealistic for a candidate to fulfil 100% of the criteria in this job description. We encourage you to apply if you feel you meet the majority of the requirements above. We know that skills evolve over time, so if you have a keen appetite to learn and evolve alongside us over time, come join our team! 

US Benefits & Perks

  • Flexible Time Off Policy – Take the time you need
  • Enhanced parental leave (16 weeks for birth parent, 8 weeks for non-birth parent at full pay) 
  • Regular company events and activities
  • Robust Company Sponsored Health & Welfare Benefits
  • 401k Plan – 4% employee match
  • Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Fridays program

We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We are at a pivotal point in our tech progression. We're looking to grow our technical estate, architect new systems, remove technical debt and scale our platform. It's an exciting time to join Partnerize, and we are looking for a technical leader to help spearhead this evolution.

As a database engineer, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy, acting as the principal technical authority and taking end-to-end ownership of our database estate. Your deep expertise in MySQL, alongside strong Linux system administration and a working knowledge of network troubleshooting, will be critical to your success. While we need your advanced technical skills, we are equally focused on character. We are looking for a highly proactive communicator who collaborates seamlessly without needing to be prompted. Crucially, you must be able to independently plan out complex technical work, such as database upgrades, and clearly articulate the step-by-step process and business impacts to stakeholders. You must thrive both when working independently to tackle complex problems and when operating collaboratively within a broader team. Furthermore, you will actively seek out opportunities to coach and mentor other engineers, elevating the overall DBA knowledge across the company. This role is fully remote and open to candidates based anywhere in the UK or the US.

As a Database Engineer at Partnerize, You Will:

  • Primary Operational Ownership: Take complete, hands-on ownership of daily database operations. Managing and maintaining the database infrastructure for day-to-day use, including backup management, resolving slow-running queries, and performance tuning, is a fundamental pillar of this role.

  • Technical Leadership & Strategy: Scope incoming work, delegate to team members where appropriate, and act as the definitive database escalation point for support teams within the wider organisation.
  • Proactive Optimisation & Automation: Measure and optimise system performance to push our capabilities forward. Lead the automation of management and monitoring for the database platform infrastructure.
  • Collaboration & Documentation: Partner closely with development teams, product owners, and other stakeholders to ensure database needs are met and to improve the testability of database aspects within software deployments. Document procedures, best practices, and troubleshooting steps for knowledge sharing.
  • Delivery & Out-of-Hours/On-Call Support: Plan, prioritise, and estimate tasks using Jira, and provide essential support for any critical database-related issues both during and outside of normal business hours.
  • Mentorship: Actively mentor and coach other engineers, providing technical leadership on database design, optimisation, and migration strategies to elevate overall team knowledge.

  • MySQL & On-Premise Infrastructure: Advanced administration of MySQL in production environments, whether on-premise or in the cloud. jobs.title: Senior Early Talent & G&A Recruiter
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is on a mission to power the connected operations that keep the world moving. As our Senior Early Talent & G&A Recruiter in EMEA, you will lead Engineering Early Talent (New Grads and Interns) and G&A hiring across multiple businesses. You will partner with regional and global leaders, build sourcing strategies that work, and give every candidate a standout experience.

You should apply if these excite you:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your work helps keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores and workers home safely, as we digitize large sectors of the global economy.
  • High-Impact Role: Direct visibility and influence with regional and global business leaders in a fast-growing organisation.
  • You are the architect of your own career: Put in the work and this role won't be your last at Samsara, with countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together and support each other, surrounded by a high-calibre team that pushes you to do your best.
  • Cutting-Edge Tools: Work with best-in-class, AI-forward recruiting technologies and data-driven strategies.

In this role, you will: 

  • Lead G&A hiring across EMEA: partner with a very diverse group of business leaders, plan hiring by function (Finance, People, Legal, IT), and switch context fast to keep every business moving.
  • Build our Early Talent programs in EMEA: lead local New Grad and Intern hiring, grow university relations and campus pipelines, and work with HQ on planning and execution and with local engineering leaders to hire early-career talent who meet our high bar.
  • Build creative sourcing strategies across LinkedIn, referrals and other channels, tailored to each function and market and backed by EMEA market intelligence.
  • Manage the pipeline from sourcing to onboarding, with an exceptional candidate experience.
  • Use data to refine recruiting strategy and influence hiring decisions.
  • Champion diversity, equity and inclusion through impactful hiring programs.
  • Work with People, Legal, Finance and Mobility to streamline hiring, including country-specific requirements.
  • Mentor peers and foster a culture of learning in the recruitment team.
  • Embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • You have 6+ years of proven full-cycle recruiting experience, preferably in a tech organisation with a very high hiring bar.
  • You have proven experience building Early Talent programs, hiring for Engineering New Grads and Interns in UK (mandatory) and G&A roles (e.g. Finance, People, Legal, IT) in EMEA.
  • You communicate with key partners in a concise, professional and pro-active way.
  • You have exceptional stakeholder management abilities and executive presence, experienced working with a very diverse population of business leaders and switching context rapidly and comfortably.
  • Innovation mindset: you're comfortable implementing new tools, technologies, and methodologies.
  • AI - forward: we would like to see strong analytical skills when looking into hiring data and forecasting hiring needs. 
  • Optimising the use of the AI tools available to create a better candidate experience and efficient workflows. No AI slop.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Deep understanding of EMEA talent market trends, turned into actionable strategies for each function.
  • Proven outbound sourcing for technical and specialist talent in a competitive market.

What's in it for you?

  • The chance to shape and build Samsara's teams across EMEA.
  • A high-visibility role: build connections and influence with Samsara's regional & global business leaders.
  • A passionate, innovative & AI-Forward team committed to excellence

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.description:
Du machst unser Wachstum steuerbar.

TEILE entwickelt und produziert High-End-Lautsprecher, DJ- und Audio-Equipment sowie Merch – Design-Objekte mit kompromisslosem Klang. Eine Brand, die man nicht nur hört, sondern auch tragen will. Unsere Systeme spielen in Clubs, auf Festivals, in Bars, Hotels und Restaurants.

Hinter TEILE steht eine weltweite Community mit sehr hoher Reichweite. Gerade bauen wir neue Vertriebskanäle auf: eigener Onlineshop, Social Commerce, Handels- und Objektpartner sowie Kooperationen mit großen Marken. Wir wachsen schnell – und bisher ohne Finanzfunktion. Es gibt kein Controlling, keine strukturierte Datenbasis, keine Systeme, die miteinander sprechen. Genau das baust du auf.

Deine Rolle

Du wirst die Person, die TEILE steuerbar macht. Du bringst den Blick eines CFO mit und baust trotzdem gern selbst – vom ersten Forecast bis zur Datenpipeline.

Dabei arbeitest du direkt mit unserem CEO und dem Gründerteam zusammen und machst KI von Anfang an zum Kern unserer Steuerung: automatisierte Reportings, datenbasierte Entscheidungen und smarte Prozesse statt manueller Routinen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Finance & FP&A aufbauen: Planung, Forecast, Liquidität und Reporting – mit einer Steuerungslogik, die mit uns skaliert.

  • Profitabilität sichtbar machen: Deckungsbeiträge pro Produkt, Kanal und Projekt – von der Werkstatt bis zum Webshop.

  • Finanzierung begleiten: Darlehen, Working-Capital-Finanzierung und Investoren-Unterlagen.

  • Eine Datenbasis für alle: Shop-, Marketing-, Produktions-, Vertriebs- und Finanzdaten in einer Plattform zusammenführen (z. B. Shopify) – Dashboards statt Excel-Silos.

  • AI-First denken: Abläufe in Finance, Marketing, Supply Chain und Customer Service automatisieren

  • Tech-Landschaft verantworten: Tools auswählen, Systeme verbinden, externe Dienstleister steuern.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Finance, Controlling oder FP&A – idealerweise in einem produzierenden Unternehmen mit physischen Produkten

  • Du hast Planung, Controlling und Reporting schon einmal selbst aufgebaut – nicht nur übernommen

  • Ein Plus: Hintergrund bei einer Big-4-Gesellschaft (PwC, KPMG, EY, Deloitte)

  • Datenaffinität: BI-Tools, Data-Warehouse-Logik, gern SQL – du baust selbst mit

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit KI-Tools und Prozessautomatisierung

  • Strategisch denkend, hands-on, pragmatisch – du brauchst kein großes Team, um zu liefern

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse

  • Ebenfalls ein Plus: Erfahrung mit Shopify und D2C

Das erwartet dich

  • Eine Schlüsselrolle mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum – du baust deinen Bereich von null auf

  • Direkter Draht zu CEO und Gründern, kurze Entscheidungswege

  • Ein Produkt, das man hört: High-End-Sound zwischen Club, Festival und Wohnzimmer

  • Starkes Wachstum, neue Kanäle, internationale Projekte – und die Perspektive, ein eigenes Team aufzubauen

  • Homeoffice nach Absprache

Arbeitsmodell

  • Standort Berlin

  • Vollzeit

  • Regelmäßige Präsenz vor Ort an beiden Standorten

jobs.title: Machine Learning Data Scientist posting
jobs.description:
Role summary:

At Differential Bio, our mission is to unlock the potential of the bioeconomy by fixing how biological R&D and scale-up are done.

We’re looking for a Machine Learning Data Scientist to join our growing cutting-edge modelling team. You will develop novel machine learning algorithms and mechanistic models of bioprocess systems and push them from research proof-of-concept into production-ready commercial use.

This role is focused on research, including creating hybrid models that combine mechanistic and machine learning approaches to predict how microbial fermentations behave, and that keep working when we move to a new organism, a new sensor, or a larger reactor. You’ll play an instrumental role on two existing grants and work with leading academic groups and industrial partners on pilot- and production-scale data. In addition, you’ll develop new research projects and drive them to completion and application on customer projects.

We’re interested in researchers who want their work to end up in real bioreactors and are excited about working at an early-stage startup. You should be comfortable owning hard, open-ended problems where nobody has the answer yet, making evidence-based decisions under uncertainty, and shipping real solutions.

How you’ll work

  • You’ll collaborate with technical leads and academic/industry external partners to design and execute research that meets our commitments in both consortia and strengthens our own platform.

  • You’ll own your research projects from scoping to delivery, with support from our modelling lead but with autonomy and independence.

  • You’ll work closely with our wet lab, dry lab and software teams, and identify which data you need to generate from our robotic lab.

Key responsibilities:

Hybrid bioprocess modelling

  • Develop hybrid mechanistic/ML cell response models that predict fermentation outcomes (growth, titer, yield, productivity) from process and sensor data.

  • Fuse time-series signals from process analytical technology (Raman, NIR, dielectric spectroscopy, dissolved oxygen, off-gas) with offline analytics.

  • Build mechanistic backbones (e.g., kinetic/ODE models, genome-scale metabolic models) that constrain learning and generate synthetic training data.

  • Develop machine learning surrogate models for computationally costly mechanistic simulations.

  • Quantify uncertainty so that models can be trusted in high-stakes production settings.

Transfer across organisms and scales

  • Design models that carry over from benchtop to pilot and production scale, and across various microbes including bacteria and yeast.

  • Use transfer learning and representation learning to make good predictions for new strains and processes with little data.

  • Develop scale-transferable reactor characterisations and predictive KPI models for scale-up.

Real-time Model-Predictive Control

  • Build the AI/ML layer for Nonlinear Model Predictive Control (NMPC) and reinforcement-learning-based feeding strategies to optimize titer, rate, and yield dynamically.

  • Fuse real-time data from Process Analytical Technology (PAT) and soft sensors (e.g., Raman, NIR) into dynamic state estimators to drive closed-loop bioreactor actuators (feed, air, agitation).

  • Prototype simpler, deployable steps along the way, such as deviation detection and operator alerts

  • Design control frameworks to proactively resolve metabolic bottlenecks and robustly account for model uncertainty, batch-to-batch variability, and inherent bioprocess stochasticity.

Qualifications:

  • PhD in machine learning, bioengineering, computational biology, or a related field, or a Master’s degree with 3+ years of relevant industry experience.

  • Strong research independence; ability to scope and execute novel scientific work from start to finish.

  • Demonstrated evidence of research contributions, including (but not limited to): peer-reviewed journal or conference papers, conference attendance, open-source contributions.

  • Strong Python and modern ML tooling (e.g., PyTorch/JAX, scikit-learn).

  • Hands-on experience building models of dynamical systems or time-series data, ideally combining mechanistic and data-driven approaches.

  • Experience working with frontier coding models, including multi-agent orchestration.

  • Clear written and verbal communication, including with non-ML partners.

Nice-to-have:

  • Experience with bioprocess or fermentation data, ideally from bioreactors at more than one scale

  • Experience with Raman, NIR, or other spectroscopic data and chemometrics (e.g., PLS)

  • Background in model-predictive control, reinforcement learning, or optimal control

  • Experience with transfer learning, domain adaptation, or representation learning on biological data

  • Familiarity with genome-scale metabolic models or kinetic modelling

  • Experience with Bayesian methods, uncertainty quantification, or design of experiments

  • Experience in collaborative or publicly funded research projects (e.g. Horizon Europe, Eurostars)

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation through salary + stock options; we are looking to build a small but mighty team and think about compensation along those lines;

  • Build your research profile: Work on open problems with leading European academic and industrial partners, with the intention to present and publish your work;

  • A beautiful office in the heart of Munich, or remote work option with occasional travel

  • eGym WellPass membership

jobs.title: AI Researcher - Pre-training (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Our Mission
Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre-training like our recently released Kolibri-1 model. Our customers - in finance, manufacturing, public administration - need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg.

We are hiring an AI Researcher (f/m/d) to join our Pre-training team and help advance the architecture and training of our next generation of foundation models. If you are excited about how large models learn, want to run experiments that feed directly into production training runs, and want hands-on time on large-scale clusters (thousands of NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs), we would love to hear from you.

Team Culture
We foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision-making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose. We collaborate closely on complex technical problems, working in pairs or using mob programming to resolve challenging issues. New team members learn through real work: from your first weeks you will pair with experienced researchers on live problems, and take on more ownership as you grow into it.

About the Role
As an AI Researcher in Pre-training (f/m/d), you will work on the technical levers that determine the success of our next-generation models: architecture, optimization, stability, and scaling.

Working at the intersection of research and engineering, you will learn to translate mathematical reasoning and empirical observations into principled training decisions, from small-scale proxy experiments to multi-thousand-GPU runs. You will start with well-scoped problems alongside senior researchers and progressively take ownership of larger parts of the training recipe.

We are looking for someone with strong fundamentals, sharp experimental instincts, exceptional skills, and the drive to go deep fast. You learn as much from a failed run as from a paper, you write code others can build on, and you want to become an expert in large-scale pre-training.

Your Responsibilities

  • Recipe & Architecture Experiments: Design and run ablations on core elements of the training recipe (optimizers, schedules, initialization), and implement PyTorch-based architectural changes. Evaluate their effect on convergence, stability, and training efficiency.

  • Scaling Experiments: Run and analyze small-scale proxy experiments, and contribute to the hyperparameter scaling laws and scale-up methods we use to predict behavior at multi-thousand-GPU scale.

  • Run Monitoring & Debugging: Help monitor large-scale training runs and investigate convergence issues such as loss spikes and divergence. Work with the team to track down distributed training failures.

  • Research to Practice: Follow the literature, reproduce promising results at small scale, and bring ideas worth testing to the team.

  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Work with the Compute Performance, Data, Evaluation, and Post-Training teams to understand how hardware constraints and the rest of the model lifecycle shape pre-training decisions.

Core Qualifications

  • You are proficient in Python and have hands-on experience with PyTorch.

  • You have a strong foundation in machine learning, shown through research (e.g., a PhD, a strong MS'c thesis, or publications), open-source contributions, or substantial professional or substantial personal projects.

  • You have a solid mathematical background (linear algebra, probability, optimization) and enjoy reasoning formally about why models train the way they do.

  • You understand how transformers work and have pre-trained LLMs from scratch yourself, even at small scale.

  • You design experiments carefully, report noisy and negative results honestly, and can explain clearly what your evidence does and does not show.

  • You have a track record of picking up unfamiliar technical areas quickly and going deep, for example by reimplementing papers, ramping up on a large new codebase, or debugging a problem well outside your comfort zone.

  • You write clean, maintainable code and care about reproducible experiments.

  • You communicate clearly, raise problems early, and actively seek out and act on feedback.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Distributed Training: Experience training models on multi-GPU or multi-node setups, or familiarity with distributed frameworks (e.g., Megatron-LM, DeepSpeed, torchtitan) and parallelism strategies (data, tensor, pipeline, expert).

  • Training Dynamics: Familiarity with scaling laws, hyperparameter transfer (e.g., µP), or recent work on optimizers and training stability.

  • Efficient Architectures: Exposure to Mixture-of-Experts, efficient attention variants, or other inference-efficient designs.

  • Research Output: Publications at top-tier venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR) or contributions to open-source ML training libraries.

  • Systems Curiosity: Low-level kernel optimization is not required, but we highly value a strong curiosity about the hardware and systems constraints that shape scale.

About the job

As an Asset Strategist at Lithosquare, you are the catalyst bridging complex geoscience, foundational AI, and high-stakes executive decisions. You will own the end-to-end impact of our partners’ engagements, embedding with top mining operators to transform real-world geological data into high-value mining assets.

You will operate directly at the intersection of technology, physical operations, and energy-transition strategy. Working alongside geologists, data scientists, and external leadership, you will serve as the primary driver for project velocity and value creation.

  • Drive partnership deployments: Own the overall operational execution of exploration partnerships, ensuring Lithosquare’s AI outputs and geology expertise translate directly into high-confidence target prioritization, accelerated field discovery and the development of valuable mining assets.

  • Lead multi-disciplinary squads: Organize cross-functional internal teams of geologists, data scientists, and AI engineers to deliver exploration roadmaps aligned with critical partner milestones.

  • Build strategic trust: Develop advisory-level relationships with partner executives and field operations teams, navigating complex organizations to identify strategic expansion opportunities.

  • Accelerate the product loop: Feed operational challenges and geological edge-cases back to our core R&D teams to continuously evolve our AI platform.

What we are looking for

  • 5–7+ years of high-impact experience in top-tier strategy consulting, tech deployment strategy, or mining project development. Experience in mining exploration projects is a bonus, but not mandatory.

  • Proven high autonomy & drive: A track record of steering complex, ambiguous projects to completion in fast-paced or field-intensive environments.

  • Degree in Engineering, Geoscience, or Management, with an ability to comfortably converse and create trust with AI engineers, field geologists, and corporate executives alike.

Perks & Benefits

jobs.location: London or remote within the UK
jobs.description:
About Griffin

Hi, we’re Griffin. We’re a fully regulated UK bank that powers the accounts and payments offerings of product-led fintechs and platforms like Uber, Yonder, Prosper, and Sidekick. By doing the heavy lifting behind the scenes, our customers can focus on what they do best - delivering amazing customer experiences.

We’ve grown rapidly since our launch in 2024, and today provide the banking backbone behind products in remittance, payroll, wealth, insurance, proptech, payments, neobanking and more.

We’re moving into card issuing, stablecoin infrastructure, and agentic finance next as we continue to support the next generation of product-led companies.

Learn more about what we do

Our culture

We believe that smart, motivated, conscientious people thrive in high-trust, high-autonomy environments and have done our best to create such an environment at Griffin. People who thrive here don’t require much hand-holding, and go out of their way to figure out how to contribute in the most valuable way possible.

We've been remote-first since we were established in 2017 and we remain so today. Work here is asynchronous and fully flexible - because we want to be a part of your life in a way that helps you to get the most out of both your work and home life.

We understand that our culture and ways of working aren’t for everyone, and we’re very intentional about our hiring process as a result. We won't hire people who don’t seem like a strong fit for our core values, even if they're otherwise extremely qualified.

Our strong culture has helped us to remain a mission-driven company as we have scaled, and gives our people a clear, explicit operating framework and the space to focus on delivering real value for our customers.

Learn more about our culture.

The team

We’re the Connect team, what most companies call Sales. We strive to bring the best in technology, user experience and banking to the embedded finance space and be the bank for fintechs and corporates to build on.

We’re 10 people across Commercial, Customers Success and Marketing, led by Phoebe, our Chief Revenue Officer and we’re currently focused on winning new businesses and selecting the right customers to partner with for long term mutual success.

The opportunity

You’ll take Griffin’s licensed bank and banking-as-a-service proposition to mid-market and enterprise companies in payments, lending, proptech, vertical SaaS, insurtech and digital assets. You’ll own each deal from first lead to signed commercial terms. You’ll show their engineering, product, risk and compliance teams how it all works, from API architecture and safeguarding to ledger flows, and talk with confidence to their CFO, COO or CTO. You’ll build your own pipeline, shape pricing for complex accounts with RevOps and Finance, and work with Legal, Compliance and Product on bespoke client needs. Think solutions architect who closes.

What success looks like

Within 12 months, you’ll have built a pipeline you sourced yourself, with deals that are bigger and more structured as you go. Prospects’ CFOs and CTOs will trust you to explain how it all works, and Legal, Compliance and Product will bring you in early on every non-standard deal.

To do this you’ll own

  • Your pipeline, from first lead to signed commercial terms, including sourcing your own leads alongside whatever SDRs and marketing bring in

  • Whiteboard sessions on account structures, and the technical proposal content, which you’ll write yourself

  • Pricing and commercial structures for complex accounts, such as consumption-based or bundled models, tiered volume and transfer pricing, built with RevOps and Finance

  • Regulatory and compliance questions, answered before they turn into objections

  • Commercial and technical arrangements for non-standard client requirements, shaped with Legal, Compliance and Product

Your background

To ensure this, we’re looking for people who have:

  • Built and closed their own pipeline, and get their energy from chasing and winning new business

  • A strong grasp of payments and banking infrastructure (settlement, safeguarding, ledgers, APIs, card and account issuing) and enough regulatory knowledge (EMI versus bank licence, Consumer Duty, safeguarding rules) to hold a credible conversation with a compliance team

  • Sold complex deals with long cycles and several buying committees, and negotiated beyond simple discounting, including pricing models, volume commitments and contractual carve-outs

  • A low ego and high curiosity, with a real appetite for understanding how the plumbing works

  • The resilience for long, technical sales cycles, and the confidence to work without a fixed script while our products and structures evolve

  • A love of writing - we have a major amount of written documentation that you will be contributing to, and we place a high degree of importance on clarity and readability (you can find out more here about how we write)


Nice to haves

Ideally, you would also:

  • Have worked at a BaaS provider, EMI or challenger bank, including in an SMCR-regulated environment

  • Have a structuring background, such as transaction structuring, treasury or Big 4 financial services advisory

What can we offer you?

We are an early stage startup and we're working hard to expand our benefits package. We're planning to add to this list in the future.

  • Salary: Up to £100,000 + commission

  • Remote-first flexibility: Work from anywhere in the UK. However, for this role you will need to be comfortable with regular travel to London, often at short notice.

  • Work from abroad: Up to 20 days a year

  • Time off: 25 days’ holiday, bank holidays and a winter break (we shut down between Christmas and New Year)

  • Share options: Own a part of what we’re building together

  • Pension: Auto-enrolment into our Penfold scheme

  • Insurance: Private medical with Bupa (including family cover) and life insurance with AIG

  • Wellbeing: 1:1 coaching and therapy session available through Oliva

  • Family leave: Enhanced parental leave with up to 6 months on full pay after two years’ service

  • AI tools: Everyone has a Claude subscription on us and access to other premium tools

  • Your setup: We’ll support you in creating a comfortable and effective WFH environment.

How long will the process take?

We move as fast as possible, but it normally takes us about 2-3 weeks to get to know to each other.

  • Step 1: An initial phone call with our Talent Team for us to tell you more about Griffin and learn about your recent experience.

  • Step 2: Meet your manager to talk through your experience and how that relates to the requirements.

  • Step 3: A task based on what you’ll be doing on a day to day at Griffin.

  • Step 4: Meet with peers in your team for a more in-depth technical interview.

  • Step 5: Pitch the Founder and CRevO

  • Step 6: Culture interview: Learn more about this here.

As a bank, we’re committed to maintaining the highest standards of security. This means that the successful candidate will need to complete background screening, and our offer will be conditional upon satisfactory review of these checks. This would include verification of right to work, criminal record, credit history, social media and professional reference checks

How do I apply?

Are we your next move? Apply via the link below, if there's a match our Talent team will reach out to schedule an initial conversation and talk you through what happens next.

Under representation

At Griffin, we’re looking for people who instinctively vibe with our values, behaviours and mission. You’re encouraged to apply, even if your experience doesn’t tick every box. Careers, like life, can take many twists and turns. Your technical expertise and path to where you are today will stand out. We're committed to creating a place where everyone belongs and we welcome diverse perspectives, backgrounds and people who are ready to build a global platform for programmable finance

Griffin Bank Ltd request that recruitment agencies do not speculatively submit CVs to any employee or associate of our company unless explicitly asked to do so by a member of our Talent team.

Any CVs sent to any member of our team on a speculative basis will not be recognised and we will not accept liability for any fee or commission should we subsequently employ a candidate who applied to us directly or was introduced by an instructed agency that may also have been submitted speculatively by an uninstructed agency.

jobs.description:
About Dotfile

Dotfile is building the AI-native Compliance Operating System for financial institutions. Our mission is to make compliance simple, safe and smart, helping financial institutions onboard customers, manage risk and operate globally.

Compliance remains one of the most manual functions in financial services. While most institutions still rely on fragmented tools and human-driven workflows, we believe AI is enabling a fundamental shift toward autonomous compliance. Our ambition is to build Level 5 Compliance: software that can gather evidence, investigate complex situations, assess risk and execute defensible decisions under defined policies.

Dotfile has grown into one of Europe’s fastest-growing compliance technology companies. Today, 100+ financial institutions across 15 countries rely on Dotfile for critical compliance operations, with a rapidly growing presence in the US.

We recently raised our Series A from leading US and European investors and software operators. We’re now entering our next chapter: investing heavily in product and AI, expanding internationally, and building the team that can make Dotfile the global standard for compliance infrastructure.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Sales Development Representative to help build the top of our sales funnel. You will be the first point of contact for many of our future customers: fintechs, crypto companies and financial institutions looking to modernise their compliance operations.

Your mission will be to identify, engage and qualify high-potential prospects, and to book meetings for our Account Executives. You will work hand in hand with Sales and the Growth team to test new outreach strategies, sharpen our messaging and turn what works into a repeatable pipeline engine.

The position is based in London, with a hybrid remote policy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prospect & qualify leads: identify and engage potential customers through outbound calls, emails, LinkedIn and other channels

  • Educate & build interest: communicate our value proposition and show how Dotfile helps fintechs, crypto companies and financial institutions streamline onboarding, strengthen compliance and scale efficiently

  • Fuel the sales funnel: book qualified meetings with high-potential prospects for our Account Executives

  • Collaborate with Sales & Growth: work closely with AEs and the Growth team to refine targeting, messaging and sequences, and to improve conversion rates

  • Track & optimise performance: keep accurate records in our CRM (HubSpot) and keep improving your outreach based on data and feedback

About you

  • You have at least 1 year of experience in a similar role, ideally in fintech, regtech or a fast-growing tech company selling to fintechs, crypto companies or financial institutions

  • Knowledge of the AML, KYC/KYB or risk management space is a strong plus

  • You are familiar with structured sales methodologies (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message…)

  • You are creative and never run out of new ideas to test, and you’re not afraid to make bold bets

  • You have strong analytical skills and a data-driven approach to your work

  • You are fluent in English and in a second language (French preferably), with excellent communication and interpersonal skills

What we offer

  • A front row seat at a fast-growing startup with global ambitions

  • A fast-learning environment with diverse career development options

  • Competitive package and medical plan

  • Hybrid remote policy with an office in Paris

The interview process

Round 1: First conversation to get to know you, understand what drives you, and explore why this role excites you.

Round 2: Deep dive into your past experiences and the choices that shaped your career.

Round 3: Case study tailored to the role, giving you the opportunity to showcase your skills on a real-world challenge.

Round 4: Reference check.

Round 5: Final conversation with our founder.
