jobs.title: Technical Strategy Manager H/F
jobs.description:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

Context

We are looking for hybrid profile, sitting at the intersection of strategy and engineering, able to rigorously evaluate the technology choices made by the R&D and innovation teams, audit our internal capabilities, and challenge product/tech trade-offs with a business lens. This is not a technical team management role, but a role of constructive counter-power and strategic alignment between engineering and business priorities.

You will ensure that our technological decisions (R&D, innovation, architecture choices, build vs buy, roadmap prioritization) are aligned with overall strategy, economically sound, and robust by actively challenging the relevant teams rather than rubber-stamping their proposals.

Role & Missions:

Strategic and technical challenge

  • Challenge the technical choices and roadmaps proposed by R&D and the Innovation team (architecture, stack, prioritization, build vs buy vs partner)

  • Question the underlying assumptions behind technical projects (feasibility, ROI, strategic alignment, technical debt incurred)

  • Produce well-argued, independent analyses not rubber-stamped validations

Technology and market watch

  • Run continuous technical and technology watch (competitors, emerging technologies, market trends, new tools, and platforms) to keep the company's decisions informed by the state of the art

  • Identify technologies or approaches that could create a competitive advantage, or expose the company to being left behind

  • Turn watch findings into actionable inputs for the R&D/Innovation roadmap and for COMEX-level strategic discussions

  • Build and maintain a structured watch process (sources, cadence, internal distribution) rather than ad hoc monitoring

Capability audit

  • Regularly map and assess the company's technical capabilities (skills, tools, infrastructure, external dependencies)

  • Identify areas of risk, over-investment, under-investment, or critical dependency

  • Benchmark our capabilities against the market and competitors

Technology strategy

  • Contribute to defining the company's technology strategy alongside the Strategy & Operations Director

  • Assess build, buy, partner, or acquisition opportunities on technology topics

  • Inform R&D resource allocation decisions with a strategic and financial lens

Reporting and governance

  • Produce syntheses and recommendations for COMEX on tech-strategy topics

  • Set up tracking indicators on technical execution vs. commitments made

  • Participate in R&D/Innovation committees as an independent strategic voice

Candidate profile

Experience

  • 5-6 years of overall experience, engineering background (degree in engineering or equivalent)

  • Ideal trajectory: 2-3 years of hands-on technical execution, followed by 2-3 years in a hybrid technical/business role e.g. Engineer → Technical Product Manager, Engineer → tech-focused strategy consulting, or Engineer → Chief of Staff to a CTO/VP Engineering

  • Profiles with only pure execution experience (no exposure to business trade-offs) or only early technical experience followed by years of generalist consulting (no longer technically credible) are not a fit for this role

  • Given the seniority level, the candidate should compensate for limited years of experience with either deep, recognized expertise in a specific technical domain (enough to be seen as a peer by R&D on that topic) or a strong, proven track record of challenging senior stakeholders from a strategy/consulting background.

Technical skills

  • Hands-on experience in a technical environment (dev, data, tech product, architecture, not consulting-only exposure)

  • Demonstrated ability to understand architecture choices and technical trade-offs, and to assess their relevance

  • Comfortable engaging as a peer with CTOs, tech leads, and senior engineers

  • Able to speak in concrete, specific terms about a real technical decision they challenged or questioned

Strategy / business skills

  • Ability to translate technical issues into business implications, and vice versa

Critical soft skills

  • Strong critical thinking and independence of judgment

  • Able to distinguish a genuine technical risk from a mere communication gap

  • Natural credibility: earns legitimacy through the rigor of the analysis, not through hierarchy

Success indicators (by month 12)

  • Technical capability map completed and kept up to date

  • A structured technology watch process in place, with regular outputs reaching R&D/Innovation and COMEX

  • Number of R&D/Innovation decisions meaningfully redirected following a well-argued challenge

  • Perceived quality of recommendations by COMEX and by the technical teams themselves

  • Measurable reduction in the gap between technical roadmap and strategic priorities

What you bring

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Frontend)
jobs.description:
Op zoek naar een werkplek waar jouw ideeën het verschil maken en waar je op niveau kan sparren met een team van ambitieuze developers? Als Software Engineer bij IXON werk je aan een modern cloudplatform dat door duizenden machinebouwers wereldwijd wordt gebruikt. Geen remote eilandjes of kortlopende projecten, maar samen bouwen aan een product waar onze klanten fan van zijn. Klaar om impact te maken?  


Hier krijg jij energie van

Binnen jouw rol als Software Engineer werk je niet aan een statische applicatie, maar aan een continu evoluerend cloudplatform met een diversiteit aan functionaliteiten. Samen met je team ben je verantwoordelijk voor het hart van de IXON Cloud: van complexe autorisatiestructuren tot een naadloze gebruikerservaring. Het doel? Onze klanten hun beheerprocessen zo efficiënt mogelijk laten uitvoeren.


Om dat voor elkaar te krijgen, werk je met een moderne tech stack die onder andere bestaat uit Angular en TypeScript. Je krijgt de vrijheid om actief mee te beslissen over technische keuzes die ervoor zorgen dat onze applicaties niet alleen vandaag snel en strak draaien, maar ook op de lange termijn schaalbaar en onderhoudbaar blijven.


Wat je concreet gaat doen: 

  • Je pakt de verantwoordelijkheid, en draagt zorg voor jouw kwalitatief sterke code;

  • Je bent een sparringpartner voor je collega’s en om features technisch uit te diepen;

  • Je tilt graag ons front-end delivery proces naar een hoger niveau, op gebied van observability, testing en deployment 

  • Je krijgt de ruimte voor PoC’s en research spikes om de nieuwste technologieën te  valideren voor ons platform.


Dit maakt jou succesvol in deze rol 

Jij bent een Software Engineer die gelooft dat een interface pas écht goed is wanneer de logica erachter vlekkeloos werkt. Frontend is jouw passie, maar je snapt ook wat er in de backend gebeurt. Dit maakt je een belangrijke schakel in ons multidisciplinaire Scrum team. Je werkt iteratief, leert van feedback en streeft voortdurend naar verbetering. Bovendien inspireer je jouw collega’s door best practices te delen en samen te groeien.


Daarnaast zou het fijn zijn als je jezelf herkent in het volgende rijtje: 

  • Je beschikt over een WO werk en denk niveau

  • Minimaal 5+ jaar relevante werkervaring; 

  • Sterke kennis van Typescript en Angular of een vergelijkbaar framework;

  • Je hebt sterke affiniteit met User Experience en begrijpt hoe een gebruiker door een applicatie beweegt;

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden zowel in het Nederlands als Engels.

  • Kennis en/of ervaring met Python en Docker.


Dit hebben wij jou te bieden

Streven naar topkwaliteit en een goede werksfeer gaan bij ons hand in hand. We streven naar ontwikkeling op hoog niveau, werken met een geavanceerde tech stack en dagen elkaar inhoudelijk uit. Tegelijkertijd is de sfeer open en informeel. Vragen stellen, kritisch meedenken of een nieuw concept pitchen? Dat hoort er bij ons gewoon bij. Daarnaast krijg je alle ruimte om nieuwe dingen uit te proberen. Leef je uit tijdens onze vrijdagmiddagprojecten, denk mee in de Frontend Guild en verbreed je horizon tijdens onze interne tech events.


Dit vullen we graag aan met: 

  • Een goed salaris passend bij jouw niveau en ervaring;

  • Uitstekende secundaire voorwaarden: Een 13e maand,  8% vakantiegeld, Vitaliteitsbudget, WIA-hiaat verzekering en een pensioenregeling;

  • 30 vakantiedagen om op te laden en thuiswerkmogelijkheden;

  • Persoonlijke groei: Een uitgebreide onboarding, ruim persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget en coaching;

  • Een gezellige werkplek inclusief een volle kalender met teamactiviteiten, uitjes en spontane borrels.


Wat wij doen? 

Bij IXON connecten wij machinebouwers met hun klanten. Naarmate machines complexer worden en de verwachtingen van klanten stijgen, moeten machinebouwers hun services continu professionaliseren om de concurrentie voor te blijven. En dat is precies waar wij in beeld komen.


Wij helpen machinebouwers wereldwijd om hun activiteiten te stroomlijnen en hun service naar een hoger niveau te tillen. Dit doen we met een pakket aan innovatieve oplossingen: van veilige remote access tot klantenportalen en geavanceerde data dashboarding. Onze oplossingen zijn ontworpen om zonder beperkingen mee te schalen en naadloos te integreren, zodat onze klanten hun services maximaal kunnen optimaliseren.


Klaar om impact te maken?

We houden van een laagdrempelige aanpak. Na een korte eerste kennismaking laten we je graag een live demo van ons platform zien. Zo ontdek je precies hoe en wat wij bouwen. Daarnaast maken we graag ruimte voor een kennismaking met het team, zodat je zelf kunt ervaren hoe de sfeer is en met wie je gaat samenwerken.

Your Profile:

  • At least 7 years of relevant professional experience in fund operations, fund controlling, fund accounting, fund administration or fund audit

  • University or FH degree in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Accounting or a comparable discipline

  • Excellent English skills; German and French are advantageous

  • A varied role combining leadership, fund operations, data and automation

  • Regular interaction with senior internal stakeholders and key external partners

jobs.title: Stage: Bedrijfsprocessen & Veiligheid
jobs.description:
Over Nedlin

Nedlin is een industriële textielverzorger voor Healthcare, Hospitality en Industry, waar veiligheid, kwaliteit, continu verbeteren en verantwoord ondernemen centraal staan. Als groeiend B-Corp familiebedrijf investeren we graag in jong talent en versterken we de verbinding tussen onderwijs en arbeidsmarkt. Daarom bieden we studenten de kans om praktijkervaring op te doen, zich te ontwikkelen en Nedlin te leren kennen, met waar mogelijk mooie doorgroeikansen na het afstuderen.

De stageopdracht

Tijdens deze hbo-stage ga je aan de slag met Lock Out Tag Out (LOTO). LOTO is een veiligheidsmethode waarbij machines en energiebronnen tijdens onderhoud of werkzaamheden veilig worden uitgeschakeld en vergrendeld. Zo wordt voorkomen dat een machine onverwacht wordt ingeschakeld terwijl eraan wordt gewerkt. Jij helpt Nedlin om deze werkwijze verder te ontwikkelen, te standaardiseren en praktisch toepasbaar te maken.

  • Je onderzoekt de huidige LOTO-werkwijze en brengt risico’s, energiebronnen en isolatiepunten in kaart.

  • Je ontwikkelt een uniforme LOTO-procedure en machine-specifieke LOTO-kaarten.

  • Je brengt de benodigde materialen en hulpmiddelen in kaart.

  • Je ontwikkelt instructie- en toolboxmateriaal voor medewerkers.

  • Je stelt een praktisch implementatieadvies op om LOTO binnen Nedlin verder te borgen.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Stagevergoeding:

    • € 300,- bruto per maand voor mbo-studenten (op basis van 40 uur per week);

    • € 400,- bruto per maand voor hbo-studenten (op basis van 40 uur per week);

  • Een leerzame stage binnen één van de modernste en duurzaamste wasserijen van Europa;

  • Ruimte en begeleiding om te werken aan jouw (afstudeer)opdracht;

  • Persoonlijke begeleiding en korte lijnen;

  • Een familiaire en positieve sfeer: samen feestdagen vieren, een jaarlijkse familiedag en leuke uitjes;

  • Kans op een (bij)baan bij Nedlin na afronding van je stage, bij wederzijdse match.

Veiligheid tijdens je stage

Veiligheid staat ook tijdens de uitvoering van de stageopdracht voorop. Je voert daarom geen risicovolle onderhoudswerkzaamheden zelfstandig uit. Eventuele technische aanpassingen worden uitsluitend uitgevoerd door bevoegde medewerkers of externe partijen. Machinekaarten worden vóór ingebruikname gevalideerd door de Technische Dienst.


Wie ben jij?

  • Je volgt een hbo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld Integrale Veiligheidskunde, Technische Bedrijfskunde, Werktuigbouwkunde, Elektrotechniek, Engineering of Facility Management.

  • Je hebt interesse in techniek en veiligheid en combineert graag theorie met praktijk.

  • Je werkt zelfstandig, nauwkeurig en proactief en communiceert gemakkelijk met collega’s.

  • Je bent 32 tot 40 uur per week beschikbaar voor een meewerk- en/of afstudeerstage.

  • Je kunt zelfstandig naar onze locatie in Elsloo of Hoensbroek reizen.

Pak het moment

Bij Nedlin krijg je de ruimte om jouw kennis vanuit je opleiding toe te passen in de praktijk, mee te kijken binnen onze organisatie en samen te werken met ervaren collega’s. jobs.title: Senior Pricing Analyst
jobs.description:
👋🏻 Hello, we're Laka

You might not have heard of us yet - that's OK, you've found us now - come and find out more about our journey...

Founded in 2017, Laka set out to transform insurance by connecting passionate cyclists to form a collective and protect their bikes for when things go wrong - a better model for insurance was born. For once people come first in insurance by fairly sharing the cost amongst each other. We exist to rewrite the rules of insurance so it’s something people stand with, not against.

Our model: Laka makes sure everything runs smoothly for The Collective - from exceptionally fast claims, splitting the cost fairly, guaranteeing a maximum price and all the other heavy lifting of a regulated insurance business. For that service, the collective pays Laka a fee relative to the claims in a month.

Take a closer look at exactly what this means and how it works here.

What have we been up to since then...?

In a nutshell, we've been very busy! Here are a few of the massive achievements we've had:

🚀 Raised $10.4 million at series B!

🚀 Grown the team to over 60 Lakanauts, based across the UK and NL, enabling a choice-based, remote-first way of working

🚀 Launched Laka in a total of 11 countries, essentially helping more people in more places!

🚀 Captured the UK and NL enthusiast cyclist market and expanded into commercial business partnering

🚀 Been awarded 'Best Cycle Insurance Provider' (for the past 8 years in a row - go us! 🥳)

🚀 Opened 3 shiny new offices in London, Bristol & Amsterdam to provide spaces for people to collaborate as they like

🚀 We've also achieved a 5* rating on Google Reviews and Glassdoor - go check us out!

Help us continue to change an outdated industry...

We’re growing real fast on our path to make the Laka collective model the industry standard and we’re expanding across segments, products, and territories. We’re looking for innovative, bold and brave minds to help us build the world’s best insurance company.

🧮 Pricing at Laka

Pricing our Collective is what makes Laka unique, so this role sits at the heart of what we do.

Each month, members pay their share of the Collective's claims and a fee for Laka's services, up to their own cap. A stop loss from our insurers picks up anything above the total of all caps. Pricing it well means keeping the Collective healthy while balancing the interests of our members, Laka and our insurance partners.

We have a fledgling pricing stack that we are looking to advance with your help.

🤘🏼 The role

You'll own pricing across all five markets and both sides of our business. One side is cyclists who buy from us direct. The other is the partners who sell or bundle our cover, from bike brands and retailers to leasing companies and delivery fleets. It's a broad, hands-on role, working with our Pricing Analyst.

What you'll be getting up to:

  • Define and deliver pricing for our Collective in the UK and Europe: members' caps, rating factors and fees, based on claims frequency and severity by market and segment.
  • Price our partner business, from bike brands and retailers to leasing companies and fleets, and support our Commercial team on new deals and renewals.
  • Prepare rate reviews and pricing proposals for our insurance partners, and work with them on stop loss and capacity terms.
  • Develop our pricing stack, tools and processes with Engineering and Data.
  • Manage and develop our Pricing Analyst.

You'll be successful by:

  • Reviewing retail and partner pricing across all five markets in your first three months and agreeing priorities with us.
  • Taking the first cap and fee changes live, with proposals our insurers approve first time.
  • Taking our pricing stack to the next level within your first year.

Requirements

🚀 Sound like you?

  • 👉🏻 This role will be a great fit if you:
    • Have 6+ years' experience in insurance pricing, with rate changes you've designed and taken live.
    • Ideally have priced both direct-to-consumer and partner or B2B business: deep in one, credible in the other.
    • Build pricing models in code: GLMs and GBMs in Python, with SQL.
    • Are sharp and commercially minded, balancing growth, retention and profitability.
    • Can explain technical work simply to partners, insurers and our leadership team.
    • Have managed or mentored an analyst and are happy to stay hands-on.
    • Already use AI tools like Claude and Claude Code, or are keen to make them core to how you work.
  • Plus points:
    • Actuarial exams (IFoA, AAG, DAV or Institut des Actuaires): welcome, but not required. We care most about what you've priced.
    • Dutch, German or French.
    • An interest in cycling.

Benefits

🌟 Our perks

🏠 Remote-first way of working - you choose whether you work from home or our beautiful offices in London, Bristol and Amsterdam(we have no minimum expectation of how many days you come in, although we'd love to see your friendly face!)

📈 Share options - we want you to be rewarded for Laka's success - everyone in the business is granted share options when they join

💰 Performance driven scheme - if the company hits its targets, you'll get a cash bonus of 5% of your base salary annually

🌴 Annual leave - 25 days holiday (plus bank holidays), with the option to roll over up to 5 days per year

💶 Pension scheme - Laka pays 3% of your base salary into your pension to help you save for the future

💊 Private medical insurance - we’ll give you individual private cover, with the option to add partners & dependants too (at a small cost)

🍽 Lunch on us - £15 every first Wednesday of the month to enjoy lunch on Laka - pop out locally with people in the office, or order-in at home, the choice is yours

💃 Company-wide events - we love getting everyone together as much as possible - expect regular events throughout the year, for team building, bonding, and general good old-fashioned fun!

🎳 Monthly socials - as if quarterly company events weren't enough, we also give each office a budget for a monthly social activity (think anything from low-key dinner & drinks through to adventure golf, paddleboarding, bowling, electric darts, trampoline parks and more!)

👚 Laka swag - we'll give you some lovely Laka kit to get you started, including a jumper & t-shirts so you can feel (& look) like part of the family

🚴 Laka credit - for all you cyclists, we'll give you £10 credit per month towards insuring your bike(s) with us - plus give you access to a bunch of cycling industry discounts

jobs.description:
ad/mbo-praktijkstage, vanaf februari 2027

Ben jij iemand die graag orde schept in de chaos?
Krijg je energie van uitzoeken, structureren en dingen overzichtelijk maken?
Werk je graag met digitale systemen?

Dit is jouw uitdaging

We hebben honderden documenten met informatie over ons beleid en genomen besluiten. Deze documenten zijn relevant voor veel collega’s. Om die reden willen we de documenten graag op een overzichtelijke manier aanbieden, zodat alle collega’s snel en makkelijk het document kunnen vinden dat ze zoeken. We hebben al een idee hoe we dit willen gaan doen. Tijdens jouw stage ga je ons idee verder uitwerken en in de praktijk toepassen.

Dit zijn de concrete activiteiten:

  • Je gaat alle beleidsdocumenten verzamelen die nu nog op verschillende plekken zijn opgeslagen.

  • Je maakt een mappenstructuur aan, waarin de documenten op een logische plek komen te staan.

  • Je deelt de documenten in volgens de nieuwe structuur en voorziet ze van labels en metadata voor een optimale vindbaarheid.

  • Je controleert of documenten dubbel voorkomen en verwijdert dubbele, verouderde en niet meer relevante documenten.

  • Je kijkt of de nieuwe structuur in de praktijk goed werkt en of gebruikers de documenten gemakkelijk kunnen terugvinden.

  • Je signaleert knelpunten en doet waar nodig voorstellen voor verbeteringen.

Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Heerlen

Je loopt stage bij het team Staf van Dataverzameling (DVZ) van het CBS in Heerlen. Vanuit deze directie wordt een groot deel van de data verzameld die het CBS nodig heeft voor zijn werk. Je krijgt dus een kijkje achter de schermen bij een organisatie die dagelijks met veel verschillende soorten data werkt.

Je staat er tijdens je stage natuurlijk niet alleen voor: je hebt collega’s om je heen bij wie je terechtkunt met vragen en ideeën. De sfeer op de afdeling is informeel en gezellig. Collega’s zijn makkelijk aanspreekbaar en helpen elkaar graag. Natuurlijk wordt er hard gewerkt, maar er is ook tijd voor een praatje bij de koffieautomaat of een gezamenlijke lunch. Als je wilt, kun je tijdens de lunch ook aansluiten bij een lunchwandeling.
Kortom: je krijgt bij ons de ruimte om praktijkervaring op te doen, nieuwe dingen te leren en echt mee te werken in een team.

Dit breng jij mee

Je volgt een ad- of mbo-opleiding informatiebeheer, administratie, business services of management support.

Je hebt kennis van en wellicht ervaring met:

  • Het werken met documenten en informatie en deze op een overzichtelijke manier ordenen.

  • Het werken met digitale programma’s en systemen en het snel wegwijs worden in nieuwe systemen.

  • Nauwkeurig en gestructureerd werken en het leuk vinden om dingen netjes en overzichtelijk te maken.

  • Samenwerken en overleggen met collega’s, vragen stellen en meedenken over hoe iets beter of makkelijker kan.

Je werkt graag netjes en gestructureerd, bent betrouwbaar en vindt het leuk om nieuwe dingen te leren. Je pakt uit jezelf dingen op, denkt mee en stelt vragen als iets niet duidelijk is. Ook vind je het prettig om samen te werken en makkelijk contact te maken met collega’s.

Dit kun je van ons verwachten

Een fijne leeromgeving waarin je:

  • praktijkervaring opdoet met document- en informatiebeheer en leert hoe je informatie overzichtelijk en goed vindbaar maakt;

  • zelfstandig aan de slag gaat, maar ook samenwerkt en overlegt met collega’s;

Met jouw ervaring help je het team bij vraagstukken die verder gaan dan het dagelijkse beheer. jobs.title: Head of Product (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Über DrAnsay

DrAnsay wurde 2018 gegründet und gehört heute zu den führenden digitalen Gesundheitsplattformen in Deutschland. Als digitales HealthTech-Unternehmen verbinden wir Patient:innen, Ärzt:innen und Apotheken und entwickeln technologische Lösungen, die Gesundheitsversorgung einfacher, schneller und zugänglicher machen. Mehr als 1 Million Patient:innen nutzen unsere Plattform bereits. Unser Anspruch ist klar: digitale Medizin so zu gestalten, dass sie im Alltag wirklich funktioniert.

Wir arbeiten schnell, direkt und mit viel Eigenverantwortung. Wer zu uns kommt, übernimmt nicht einfach nur eine bestehende Rolle, sondern gestaltet Strukturen, Prozesse und Entscheidungen aktiv mit.

Warum es diese Rolle gibt

DrAnsay befindet sich in einer Scale-up-Phase: Die Grundstrukturen der Produktorganisation stehen. Der Fokus liegt jetzt auf Optimierung, Effizienz und der Weiterentwicklung bestehender sowie neuer Produktinitiativen. Unser CPO verantwortet gleichzeitig kommerzielle und strategische Themen der Unternehmensführung. Neue Initiativen brauchen deshalb eine Person, die produktübergreifend Struktur schafft und den Takt hält.

Die Position wird neu geschaffen, um diese Lücke zu schließen. Das ist keine Rolle, in der du Grundlagen aufräumst. Es geht darum, dass wir neue Produkte schneller starten und bei bestehenden Produkten an den richtigen Dingen arbeiten.

Deine Rolle

Als Head of Product übernimmst du die Koordination produktübergreifender Roadmaps und OKR-Zyklen, verantwortest das unternehmensweite Produkt-Reporting und sorgst dafür, dass Metriken, Feature-Impact und Produktstrategie intern klar kommuniziert werden. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO und bist Schnittstelle zu einem neunköpfigen Produktteam aus Senior Product Managern und einem UX-Team sowie zu Data, Marketing und Engineering.

Dein Ziel in den ersten Monaten ist es, alle Produktbereiche, unseren Markt und das Team gründlich zu verstehen. Du erkennst, wo Planung, Zusammenarbeit und Dokumentation besser werden können, machst einen Plan und setzt ihn um.

Was du konkret machst

  • Produktübergreifende Roadmaps über mehrere Produktlinien und Teams hinweg koordinieren, aktuell halten und Abhängigkeiten zwischen Teams früh erkennen und auflösen

  • OKRs und Key Results auf Team-Ebene mit der übergeordneten Produktstrategie verknüpfen und die Zyklen von der Planung bis zur Auswertung begleiten

  • Die Produkt-Metriken und das unternehmensweite Reporting zum Feature-Impact verantworten, gemeinsam mit unserem Data-Team

  • Vorhaben hinterfragen, die zu wenig Kunden- oder Geschäftswert schaffen, und Alternativen vorschlagen

  • User Research strukturiert in laufende Produktentwicklung einbinden, gemeinsam mit unserem Head of UX und dem UX-Team

  • Die Arbeitsweise unserer Product Manager weiterentwickeln, besonders Planung, Dokumentation und Reporting

  • Product Discovery und die frühe Teamstrukturierung neuer Produktinitiativen unterstützen, inklusive Abstimmung mit Engineering

  • Die unternehmensweite Kommunikation zur Produktstrategie aufbauen und Produktentscheidungen für alle nachvollziehbar dokumentieren


Das brauchst du

  • Erfahrung in einer Product-Leadership-Rolle, etwa als Head of Product, Product Lead oder Group Product Manager. Du hast über dein eigenes Produkt hinaus Verantwortung getragen, für mehrere Product Manager, Teams oder Produktbereiche, fachlich oder disziplinarisch

  • Erfahrung mit digitalen Produkten für Endkund:innen (B2C) in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen

  • Praxis mit OKRs und Roadmapping: Du hast OKR-Zyklen produktübergreifend koordiniert und Roadmaps für mehrere Teams gepflegt und kommuniziert

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Produktkennzahlen: Du hast Metriken definiert, Feature-Impact gemessen und Reporting für interne Stakeholder aufgebaut

  • Du überzeugst über Argumente und Zahlen, nicht über deine Position, und diskutierst auch mit erfahrenen Product Managern auf Augenhöhe

  • Die Bereitschaft, auch die Strukturarbeit selbst zu machen: Roadmaps pflegen, Updates einfordern, Reporting am Laufen halten

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mindestens C1), weil du täglich in beiden Sprachen mit Product, Engineering und Leadership arbeitest

  • Du kannst die Tätigkeit dauerhaft aus Deutschland ausüben und verfügst zum Start über die hierfür erforderliche Arbeitserlaubnis

Das fällt positiv auf

  • Erfahrung als Head of Product. Voraussetzung ist sie nicht

  • Mehrjährige eigene Produktverantwortung als Product Manager, bevor du in eine Leadership-Rolle gewechselt bist

  • Erfahrung aus einer größeren Produktorganisation mit ausgereiften Arbeitsweisen

  • Erfahrung mit Roadmap- und Produktmanagement-Tools wie airfocus, Productboard, Jira Product Discovery oder Aha!

  • Erfahrung mit Produktanalyse-Tools wie PostHog, Amplitude oder Mixpanel

  • Produkterfahrung in E-Commerce, Marktplätzen oder Digital Health

  • Erfahrung in stark regulierten Produktumfeldern

  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit UX-Teams und der Einbindung von User Research

Was wir bieten

  • Vollzeit und unbefristet, Start ab November 2026

  • 100% Remote: Du arbeitest aus Deutschland, Vollzeit, ohne Standortbindung

  • Eine Rolle, die mitwächst: Je tiefer dein Verständnis von Produkten, Markt und Team, desto mehr Entscheidungen übernimmst du

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit unserem CPO und Zeit, alle Produktbereiche gründlich kennenzulernen

  • Sichtbare Wirkung: Du prägst, wie DrAnsay neue Produkte startet und woran das Product-Team arbeitet

  • Kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen, Low-Ego-Kultur und direktem Feedback

  • Ein Produkt mit realem Nutzen: Wir helfen täglich Menschen, Gesundheitsversorgung einfacher zu bekommen

Wie du dich bewirbst

Bewirb dich direkt über das Bewerbungsformular. Kein Anschreiben erforderlich, wir stellen dir einige kurze Fragen, die uns helfen zu verstehen, wie du arbeitest. Diese Antworten sind uns wichtiger als dein LinkedIn-Profil.

Du hörst von uns innerhalb von fünf Arbeitstagen.

DrAnsay ist ein chancengleicher Arbeitgeber. Bewerbungen werden auf Basis von Qualifikationen und Berufserfahrung bewertet. Alle Bewerbenden werden unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Herkunft, Behinderung, Religion oder anderen geschützten Merkmalen berücksichtigt. DrAnsay verarbeitet die mit deiner Bewerbung übermittelten personenbezogenen Daten zur Durchführung des Recruitingprozesses.

jobs.description:
Méthodes numériques et d’intelligence artificielle combinée à une approche expérimentale pour concevoir des matériaux et dispositifs de stockage de l’énergie à partir de composites biocarbone à base de graphite.

ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE :

École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation.

Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être.

IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient.

Le poste est à pourvoir au sein du Centre RAPSODEE (Recherche d'Albi en génie des Procédés des SOlides Divisés, de l'Energie et de l'Environnement), unité mixte de recherche CNRS dédiée aux procédés, matériaux et énergies durables.

Le Postdoc sera dirigé par le professeur Ange Nzihou et codirigé par un chercheur de l'université de Princeton (États-Unis).

 

DESCRIPTION DU POSTE :

Ce travail s’inscrit dans un projet ERC (European Research Council) Advanced Grant. L’ERC est une organisation européenne de financement qui soutient des projets de recherche de rupture à travers des appels à projets très compétitifs, dans le cadre du programme Horizon Europe de l’Union européenne.

Le projet ERC vise à évaluer la capacité de stockage de composites innovants en biocarbones. Il s’agit d’une famille de matériaux carbonés avancés et durables issus de la biomasse, permettant de stocker l’énergie dans différents environnements, contrairement à la plupart des solutions actuelles reposant sur des matériaux d’origine fossile ou non durables. Cela devrait se traduire par une réduction notable des émissions de CO₂ et des économies d’énergie. Les travaux seront menés dans un environnement international, avec des visites régulières dans les laboratoires de partenaires en France, en Inde et aux États-Unis.

Nous recherchons un chercheur ou une chercheuse très motivé(e) pour contribuer à la conception et au développement de matériaux et de dispositifs de stockage de l’énergie avancés et performants, en combinant des méthodes de calcul, l’intelligence artificielle (IA) et des approches expérimentales.

L’objectif est de développer et d’appliquer des modèles numériques, des méthodes fondées sur les données et des outils utilisant l’IA afin de prédire les propriétés des matériaux, d’optimiser leur composition et leur structure, et d’améliorer la capacité et les performances de stockage de l’énergie. Les travaux combineront des études théoriques et numériques avec la synthèse expérimentale, la caractérisation, la validation et l’optimisation de solutions innovantes de stockage de l’énergie.

Un axe important du projet portera sur l’étude des propriétés thermophysiques, thermomécaniques et de stabilité thermique de composites à base de biocarbone graphitique. Le/La candidat(e) étudiera les relations entre la structure des matériaux, leurs propriétés fonctionnelles, leur comportement et les performances globales du dispositif en conditions d’utilisation, afin de contribuer au développement de technologies de stockage de l’énergie sûres, efficaces et durables.

Compétences, connaissances et expériences souhaitables :

• Solides compétences en sciences computationnelles, en méthodes apprentissage automatique (machine learning) et en méthodes fondées sur l’intelligence artificielle
• Solides compétences en caractérisation des matériaux, en recherche expérimentale et dans les technologies de stockage de l’énergie
• Bonnes compétences en programmation

Capacités et aptitudes :

• Rigueur scientifique, capacité d’analyse et de synthèse
• Autonomie et esprit d’initiative
• Capacité à travailler dans un environnement de recherche international et interdisciplinaire
• Bonne communication écrite et orale en anglais

 

PROFIL RECHERCHE :

Diplôme de doctorat (PhD) en génie des procédés, science des matériaux, génie énergétique, physique, sciences computationnelles ou dans un domaine connexe.

 

AU-DELÀ DE L’ENVIRONNEMENT PROFESSIONNEL, POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ? :

  • 49 jours de congés par an

  • restauration administrative sur place

  • aide à la mobilité durable pour le transport domicile-travail

    Catégorie du poste et métier de référence :  Catégorie II, Métier R – Ingénieur de recherche

Cette plateforme technologique rassemble des installations et des équipements technologiques dédiés aux activités de R&D en micropackaging, micro- et nano-électronique, au sein d'une salle blanche de 220 m² en classe 1000 et de 400 m² en classe 10 000.

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous

En tant que stagiaire, le/la candidat(e) réalisera des innovations et des activités de recherche dans le domaine de l’électronique. Au sein du département d’électronique flexible (FEL) du Centre de Microélectronique de Provence (CMP), le/la candidat(e) combinera passion des science et désir d’impact sociétal.

Ce stage fait partie du projet de recherche Sens-CO qui met en partenariat l’Université Gustave Eiffel, l’Ecole polytechnique et l’Ecole des mines de Saint-Etienne. Ce projet vise à développer un capteur de gaz NOx et COx portable pour un monitoring environnemental en continu. La résistance interne du capteur varie avec la concentration de gaz mesurée. Le rôle du CMP est d’obtenir précisément la valeur de cette résistance à travers un circuit électronique et de permettre la corrélation avec la concentration en gaz ainsi que le traitement et l’envoi des données par communication sans contact. Ce circuit doit permettre une mesure portable et nécessite donc d’être réalisé sur un substrat flexible.

Le/la candidat(e) devra ainsi, à partir d’un design réalisé sur PCB rigide, transposer cette interface de capteur de gaz sur un substrat souple en tenant compte des enjeux liés à ces méthodes. Compte tenu de la grande valeur des résistances à mesurer, le PCB final devra permettre :

·         Une mesure précise de grandes valeurs de résistance

·         Un faible-bruit et résistance aux interférences électromagnétiques, en tenant compte de l’agencement des composants pour permettre de garantir une flexibilité maximale.

Les dispositifs électroniques biorésorbables constituent une approche prometteuse pour le développement de systèmes électroniques temporaires, notamment dans le domaine biomédical. Ces dispositifs sont conçus pour assurer une fonction spécifique avant de se dégrader progressivement, ce qui nécessite le développement de matériaux adaptés et de solutions de stockage de l’énergie compatibles avec cette approche.

jobs.description:
Mission principale

Rattachée à la Head of HR Operations, le/la HR Data & Social Controlling Analyst assure le pilotage de la masse salariale et des effectifs, tout en développant une approche analytique et data-driven de la fonction RH.

Il/elle garantit la fiabilité des données sociales, contribue à la construction et au suivi du budget RH, automatise les reportings et transforme les données RH en analyses pertinentes en étroite collaboration avec la Direction Financière.

Principales responsabilités

A. Contrôle de gestion sociale et pilotage de la masse salariale

  • Exploiter et croiser les données issues du SIRH, de la paie, du recrutement et des autres outils RH.

  • Traduire les résultats des analyses en recommandations compréhensibles et directement exploitables par les équipes RH et les managers.

C. Reporting, Business Intelligence et automatisation

  • Concevoir, maintenir et faire évoluer les tableaux de bord RH et les reportings destinés à la DRH, au CODIR et aux équipes opérationnelles.

  • Automatiser la production des reportings récurrents afin de réduire les tâches manuelles et de sécuriser les résultats.

  • Développer des dashboards interactifs permettant de suivre les indicateurs clés et d'analyser les données par métier, entité, pays, population ou niveau hiérarchique.

  • Harmoniser les définitions, les règles de calcul et les référentiels des indicateurs RH.

  • Contribuer à l'amélioration de la qualité, de la cohérence et de la disponibilité des données sociales.

  • Participer à l'évolution des outils de reporting et à l'optimisation des processus de collecte et d'exploitation des données.

D. Projets RH

  • Participer activement à l’ensemble des exercices annuels liés aux sujets Comp & Ben :

  • Révision annuelle des salaires, évaluation des bonus, plan de commissionnement pour les équipes de vente.

  • Etudes de rémunérations, benchmarks internes et externes.

Profil recherché

Formation

  • Bac +5 en contrôle de gestion, finance, statistiques, data analytics, ressources humaines ou école de commerce avec spécialisation pertinente.

  • Une double compétence en finance et en data constitue un atout.

Expérience

  • 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en contrôle de gestion sociale, HR Analytics, contrôle de gestion ou analyse de données, idéalement avec une exposition aux problématiques RH.

  • Une expérience dans le retail, la mode, le luxe ou un environnement multi-entités est appréciée.

Compétences techniques

  • Excellente maîtrise d'Excel et des fonctions avancées d'analyse de données.

  • Bonne maîtrise de Power BI.

  • Capacité à manipuler, consolider et analyser des données provenant de plusieurs systèmes.

  • Bonne compréhension des mécanismes de masse salariale, des rémunérations, des effectifs et des principaux indicateurs sociaux.

jobs.title: Clinical Solutions Consultant
jobs.description:
About Rivia

Rivia is a technology company building a data engine that powers the future of clinical trial intelligence. Rivia was founded on the belief that new drugs can be brought to market more successfully with a fraction of today's capital.

Biotechs are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is constantly constrained by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia unifies clinical trial data at scale through a core engine built as a reusable intelligence layer, comprising hundreds of configurations and trial-specific logic, independent of source structure. This vertical stack of data engine, workflows, and agents creates a distinct advantage in how trials are operated.

Over the past two years, European- and US-based biotechs running global clinical trials on Rivia have demonstrated measurable impact, from earlier understanding of therapeutic potential to significantly more efficient trial execution. In March 2026, Rivia raised its $15M Series A led by Earlybird Venture Capital.

Rivia's ambition is to become the standard infrastructure for modern drug development, transforming how trials are executed end-to-end.

The Role

As our Clinical Solutions Consultant, you'll be the bridge between science, technology, and sales, helping biotech and pharma companies understand how Rivia can transform the way they work with clinical trial data.

You'll partner closely with our Account Executives throughout the technical stages of the sales cycle, turning complex scientific and technical challenges into compelling product demonstrations, tailored sandboxes, and solutions that address real customer needs.

This isn't a role where you simply present slides or follow a demo script. You'll need to understand clinical trial workflows, get hands-on with data, challenge assumptions, and translate complex customer requirements into solutions we can actually deliver.

You'll also play an important role in shaping how we approach technical pre-sales at Rivia, building repeatable processes, improving our demo environments, and helping us scale without losing the scientific depth and customer understanding that make us different.

What Excites You

  • Bringing science and technology together: You love understanding complex scientific challenges and translating them into practical, impactful solutions.

  • Being hands-on: You don't just talk about what a product can do. You enjoy building demos, configuring sandboxes, working with data, and showing customers what's possible.

  • Making an impact on revenue: You enjoy being part of the sales process, influencing strategic deals, and helping customers confidently make decisions.

  • Solving real customer problems: You're curious about how biotech and pharma companies operate and enjoy finding creative ways to address their challenges.

  • Building from the ground up: You get excited about joining a growing company where you can shape processes, improve tools, and help establish how technical pre-sales should work.

  • Working across teams: You enjoy collaborating with Sales, Product, and Engineering, balancing commercial opportunities with technical feasibility.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with Account Executives as the scientific and technical expert throughout the sales process, helping prospects understand how Rivia can address their specific challenges.

  • Lead in-depth product demonstrations tailored to customers' clinical trial workflows, data structures, and scientific requirements.

  • Build and configure customized sandboxes, demo environments, and prototype integrations to demonstrate Rivia's value using realistic customer scenarios.

  • Understand customers' clinical trial pipelines, protocols, endpoints, and data challenges, translating their needs into practical technical solutions.

  • Scope prospective customer implementations, identifying technical requirements, dependencies, risks, and feasibility before commercial commitments are made.

  • Collaborate closely with Solutions Engineers and Customer Engagement to ensure smooth handovers from pre-sales to implementation.

  • Act as a trusted technical advisor to both customers and internal teams, confidently addressing complex scientific questions while being transparent about product capabilities and limitations.

  • Adapt demonstrations and technical conversations to customers' familiarity with and readiness to adopt AI-driven solutions.

  • Identify recurring customer needs, technical objections, and product gaps, sharing insights with Product and Engineering to continuously improve our offering.

  • Help develop scalable pre-sales processes, reusable demo environments, and technical documentation as Rivia grows.

What Excites Us

  • Scientific background: You have a degree in life sciences, bioinformatics, biomedical engineering, or a related scientific discipline, and you're comfortable navigating complex scientific discussions.

  • Relevant experience: You bring at least 4 years of client-facing experience in solutions consulting, technical pre-sales, field application science, technical account management, or similar roles.

  • Scientific and technical fluency: You understand scientific data and experimental logic, and can quickly grasp complex clinical trial workflows and technical requirements.

  • Hands-on technical skills: You've personally built and configured product demos, sandboxes, or technical proof-of-concepts, rather than only presenting solutions developed by others.

  • Commercial mindset: You understand how technical expertise contributes to winning deals and enjoy working closely with sales teams to move opportunities forward.

  • Customer-facing confidence: You can communicate complex technical concepts clearly and credibly, whether you're speaking with scientists, clinical operations leaders, or technical stakeholders.

  • Strong ownership: You're proactive, independent, and comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where processes are still being built.

  • Collaborative approach: You know when to challenge assumptions, push back on unrealistic commitments, and work across teams to deliver the best outcomes for customers.

Bonus / Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in scientific software, clinical trial technology, biotech platforms, or laboratory informatics.

  • Familiarity with clinical trial protocols, endpoints, regulatory considerations, and clinical data integration.

  • Experience working with AI-driven products or communicating the value of AI to scientific and technical stakeholders.

Our Values

  • In It to Win It: Approach every challenge with determination, resilience, and a drive to achieve the best possible outcomes.

  • Embrace Change: We see change as an opportunity for growth, innovation, and improvement, continuously evolving to stay one step ahead.

  • Why Not?: We challenge assumptions, stay curious, and explore new possibilities rather than accepting things as they are.

  • Find the Gap: We proactively identify opportunities, anticipate challenges, and solve problems before they arise.

  • Collective Accountability: We're one team, on one mission, committed to shared responsibility, mutual support, and trust.

  • Value Add Solutions: Know better. Act better. We're dedicated to delivering meaningful solutions that create real impact.

jobs.title: Audit Methodology Lead
jobs.description:
We build AI agents that perform audit procedures for audit firms. We need an experienced auditor to decide what correct output from those agents looks like, and whether our agents meet that bar.

You'll join one of our product groups as its audit expert. You'll write the criteria and reference cases our agents are tested against, review agent output the way you'd review a file, and tell the team plainly when something isn't ready for a live engagement. You'll use AI to create realistic test material, and you'll review all of it yourself.

About DataSnipper

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.

 

What you'll own

  • Define the correct answer, and the reasoning behind it, for the procedures our agents perform

  • Interpret ISAs and NV COS (IFRS for reporting matters; US GAAS and PCAOB where relevant) into requirements engineers can build against

  • Create realistic audit cases with AI tools, including documents, workpapers, exceptions and judgement calls, and review every one

  • Review agent output against those cases, and find misapplied standards, weak reasoning and conclusions that wouldn't pass partner review

  • Turn recurring errors into findings product and engineering can fix

  • Give a clear, evidenced view on whether a capability is ready for live engagements

  • Review methodology content from partners and our own teams, with versioning, approval and documented changes

  • Track changes in standards and inspection findings, and explain what they mean for the product

  • Teach product and engineering how audit work is actually done, including how firms differ

  • Work with customers and content partners when the work requires it

What you'll bring

  • A professional qualification: RA, AA, CPA, CA, ACA, ACCA or equivalent

  • Experience as an Audit Manager: setting the approach, reviewing others' work, clearing review notes and defending conclusions

  • Recent experience across several clients and industries

  • Working knowledge of ISQM 1 and how firms document and review audit work

  • Regular use of AI tools, and a clear sense of how they fail

  • Precise writing: people without your training will build from what you write

  • Patience for detail: line-by-line review, and real time spent on a single conclusion

Nice to have:

  • You want to use your audit expertise on hard problems in AI: judgement, evidence and review

  • You'd rather change how audit work is done than automate how it's done today

  • You've built something yourself, such as a tool, prototype or workflow, to fix a slow process

  • You stay with open-ended problems until the answer holds up

What this role is not

  • Not product management. You shape what ships, but you don't own the roadmap

  • Not implementation or customer success

  • Not volume work. AI produces the volume; you decide what's right

  • Recruiter screen

  • Assessment interview

  • Final conversations with the people you would work alongside

We're a group of friends building apps for friends, and we think friendship deserves a better place online. Our brand is how the world first meets that idea, usually in a three-second scroll, in a language that isn't ours, on a phone in a city we've never been to.


We're looking for a Brand Lead who writes like a dream and ships like a machine. Someone who's run global campaigns at a top agency, knows what a great brief feels like, and is ready to trade the client side of the table for owning the whole thing.


You'll shape how amo sounds, looks and shows up everywhere, from a two-word push notification to a launch film watched in fifteen countries.

What you'll do:

  • Own the amo voice. Write it, guard it, and make it better every week. App copy, launch posts, store listings, social, scripts, the little lines that make people smile.

  • Run global campaigns end to end. From the first idea on a napkin to the last cut in market, across Europe, the US and beyond.

  • Brief and push creative partners. Agencies, directors, creators and our in-house design team. You know how to get their best work because you've been on their side of the table.

  • Make the brand local without making it boring. Adapt ideas so they land in Paris, London, LA and Seoul, not just translate them.

  • Measure what the brand is really doing. Set up and run brand tracking across our markets, following awareness, consideration and perception over time, and turn what you learn into the next brief.

  • Work in days, not weeks. Spot a moment on Tuesday, have a campaign live on Thursday, learn from it on Friday.

  • Sweat the details. Easter eggs, onboarding screens, the name of a feature. Small words do big work here.

What that may look like:

Kicking off a campaign with an agency for our next market launch, and setting up the tracker that tells us a month later whether people there know who we are and like what they see.

Who you are:

  • A writer first. You can make a headline sing and kill your darlings without blinking. Your portfolio proves it.

  • Agency-trained. You've spent real time at a creative agency and worked on brands people actually know. You've sat in the pitch, survived the feedback round and shipped anyway.

  • Global from day one. You've led or played a key role in campaigns that ran across several markets at once, and you know what changes (and what never should) from one country to the next.

  • Fast and opinionated. Conviction over consensus. You'd rather put out something great today than something perfect next month.

  • Fluent in internet. You know what's trending before it trends, and you can tell the difference between a moment worth joining and one worth skipping.

  • Bilingual or better is a plus. English is our working language. French, Spanish, Portuguese, Korean or Japanese would make us very happy.

Bonus points if:

You've worked on a consumer app, built a brand from scratch, or have a group chat that's funnier than most ad campaigns.

Why amo:

  • You'll own it. No account director, no client sign-off chain. Your ideas go from your head to millions of phones.

  • You'll move fast. We make decisions quickly and learn from mistakes even quicker. Intense, but healthy.

  • You'll be in good company. Over half the team is international, with 25 nationalities and counting. One in four of us moved cities or countries to be here.

  • You'll grow x10. Colleagues across product, design, engineering and growth will challenge your work every day, and you'll do the same to theirs.

  • You'll have backing. We're supported by some of the best tier-1 investors in the world and growing at a pace our space hasn't seen in years.

Life at amo:

To ensure that everyone is set up for success within our way of working, we work together onsite 5 days a week. We wanted to make sure coming to the office is as comfortable as possible for you:

  • We chose a location in central Paris, near Opera (Metro lines 3,8,9 and RER A).

  • We have a beautiful Parisian-style office with high ceilings, balconies, and huge windows. So a lot of natural light!

  • We reimburse your commuting expenses 50%.

Because life outside of work should also be stress-free, we cover:

  • Health care (100% coverage).

  • Maternity Leave, Paternity Leave, Second Parent Leave (salary maintained at 100%).

  • Vacation days: 8-9 weeks (total) per year - (European summer? 🥹😎).

    • 5 weeks of paid time off (by the state);

    • 1-2 additional weeks (RTT, based on our company contract);

jobs.description:
About myTomorrows 

myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options.   

We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem.   

We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection.   

With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business.  

Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. 

The opportunity: Senior People Business Partner

As a Senior People Business Partner at myTomorrows, you are a trusted advisor to senior leaders and the Leadership Team. This is our most senior individual contributor People Business Partner role, where you translate business priorities into practical people solutions that enable high performing teams and organizational growth.

You partner closely with leaders across the organization to strengthen leadership effectiveness, organizational design, performance, engagement, and talent development. You enjoy balancing strategic thinking with hands on execution and are comfortable navigating the pace, ambiguity, and opportunities of a fast growing international scale up.

Given that most of our team is located in the Netherlands, we only consider candidates who live within commuting distance of our Amsterdam office.

What you'll do in this role:

  • Partner with senior leaders and Leadership Team members on organizational design, workforce planning, team effectiveness, and organizational health.

  • Coach leaders on performance management, leadership effectiveness, feedback, development, and difficult people conversations.

  • Lead complex employee relations cases, including performance improvement, conflict resolution, absence management, and sensitive exits.

  • Drive and continuously improve key People programs, including performance management, engagement, talent reviews, succession planning, and career development.

  • Translate business strategy into practical People initiatives that support organizational growth and scalability.

  • Use people data and insights to identify trends, challenge assumptions, and recommend actions that improve engagement, retention, and organizational performance.

  • Partner closely with Talent Acquisition and People Operations to deliver an outstanding employee experience across the entire employee lifecycle.

  • Ensure consistent application of People policies, employment legislation, and People practices across your business areas.

  • Lead cross functional People projects that improve organizational effectiveness, manager capability, and operational excellence.

  • Act as a trusted sparring partner who balances strategic thinking with hands on execution.

What you bring to the table:

  • At least 6 years of experience as an HR Business Partner or People Business Partner in a fast growing international organization.

  • Demonstrated experience partnering with senior leaders on organizational and people topics.

  • Extensive experience managing complex employee relations, performance management, and organizational change.

  • Strong coaching, influencing, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Solid knowledge of Dutch employment law and HR best practices.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate people data into actionable business insights.

  • Comfortable operating independently, making sound judgments, and managing competing priorities.

  • Experience working in a technology, SaaS, HealthTech, or scale up environment is highly preferred.

  • Experience with modern HR systems such as Personio is a plus.

  • Experience supporting international teams is a plus.

What we offer:

  • Serve a purposeful mission by helping patients gain access to potentially lifesaving treatments.

  • International work environment with scale up energy and a flat organization.

  • Competitive salary, annual performance bonus, and equity.

  • Great career development opportunities in a growing company.

  • Learning and development budget alongside internal knowledge sharing sessions.

  • Attractive pension plan with the full premium covered by us.

  • Hybrid working model.

  • Policies that support working parents.

  • Healthy lunch at the office.

  • Unlimited access to professional guidance by certified psychologists through OpenUp.

  • An additional holiday every year to celebrate Liberation Day on May 5.

Equal opportunities

myTomorrows is an Equal Opportunity Employer and, beyond upholding discrimination-free practices, we are committed to cultivating a workplace where difference and diversity are protected and celebrated. The best work comes from our best selves, and we go to great lengths in supporting our team members to be just that.

jobs.title: Brand & Web Designer
jobs.description:
Hi, I'm Rosa, Head of Brand at FeedbackFruits. 👋

As FeedbackFruits evolves, so does the role design plays in how we build and communicate our brand. Campaigns and marketing materials will always be part of the picture, but we're putting a much bigger focus on our website, our digital experiences and the brand systems that help us do better work, more consistently.

I'm looking for a brand designer with a strong B2B marketing background, someone who combines excellent visual craft with real, hands-on website experience. You'll help evolve our visual identity, develop creative concepts for campaigns and launches, and bring that work to life on our website and landing pages, from the first layout to the moment a page goes live.

The first project you'd pick up with me is one I'm particularly excited about: evolving our brand so it sits closer to the new visual language of our product. After that, you'll take ownership of our website and landing pages, shaping the direction together with me while owning the design and execution, and you'll make sure our brand shows up consistently wherever people come across us, from a launch campaign to an ebook.

Beyond the design itself, I'm looking for someone who takes real ownership: someone who asks the right questions before jumping into a brief, spots what could be better and isn't afraid to challenge the obvious solution. We also use AI a lot at FeedbackFruits, and I'd love you to bring that same mindset to design, building templates and systems that help the whole team create on-brand work without starting from scratch every time. You'll have a real say in our creative direction, and as the team grows, there's room for you to grow with it.

What you'll do:

  • Evolve our brand identity and translate it into a distinctive, coherent visual language across our website, campaigns and marketing materials

  • Design and improve our marketing website and landing pages, from early concepts and layouts to responsive designs, and build and maintain pages yourself

  • Develop creative concepts for campaigns and product launches, and carry them through to ads, social, ebooks, brochures, presentations and event materials

  • Create hero and product visuals that make a complex product clear and compelling

  • Make our website clearer, more engaging and easier to navigate, with an eye on accessibility and conversion

  • Build reusable components, templates and guidelines so colleagues can create on-brand materials themselves

  • Bring structure to how design work gets requested, briefed, reviewed and delivered, and find ways for AI and automation to take repetitive work off the team's plate

  • Brief and work with external specialists in development, motion, video or illustration when a project needs extra expertise

What you bring:

  • You have around 3–5 years of experience as a brand or marketing designer, ideally at a B2B tech or SaaS company, or at an agency working with B2B clients

  • Your portfolio shows real breadth in B2B marketing design: landing pages, ads, brochures, ebooks, hero visuals and product visuals. You know how to make a complex product easy to understand and good to look at

  • Website work is a regular part of your job, not an occasional task. You've designed and built marketing pages yourself and can explain what you owned. You work in Webflow, our platform, or in something comparable like Framer and are happy to switch

  • You think in concepts, not just layouts, and you have a strong eye for typography, composition and hierarchy

  • You can take a project from a fuzzy brief to delivery without someone managing it for you, and you keep a clear head about priorities when several people need something from you at once

  • You understand what design needs to do for marketing, and you can explain your choices to non-designers in a way that brings them along

  • You look for ways to work smarter, whether that's a template, a component or an AI workflow that saves the team hours

  • You're confident in Figma and communicate well in English

  • You live within commuting distance of Amsterdam and are available 38 hours per week, with at least 2 days a week from our Amsterdam office

What you get:

  • 25 paid holidays per year

  • Hybrid work schedule (2 days onsite)

  • A day off for your birthday

  • Advantageous pension scheme

  • 3 days of volunteering leave per year

  • €550 Learning & Development budget per year + 3 days paid leave for learning

  • Travel allowance and Swapfiets subscription

  • Free access to our office gym

  • Unlimited access to mental health support via OpenUp

Compensation: €65K – €70K

  • • Estimaded gross yearly salary, including 8% holiday allowance €65K – €70K

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Hi, I'm Killian, VP Engineering at FeedbackFruits. 👋

We're moving to one Engineering Manager per squad, and we’re looking for an Engineering Manager for our System Squad. It's our most product-heavy squad: five engineers, three senior and two medior, building the learning tools that teachers and students around the world use every day. Because so much of the squad's work is shaped by what those users need, whoever leads it works closely with the Product Manager on what we build as well as on how we build it.

We're looking for an Engineering Manager with engineering depth, someone senior engineers respect on code and architecture, who has chosen to focus on growing people and still cares a lot about the product. You'd own how the squad works, set its technical standards and lead the way in how it uses AI, and you'd help raise the bar across the wider engineering department too. Our stack is Ruby on Rails and Ember.js, and experience with either is welcome but not required.

What you'll do:

  • Co-own the backlog and roadmap with the Product Manager: challenge scope on user value, propose smaller first versions and turn product goals into technical plans

  • Lead the squad's day-to-day delivery, from planning to unblocking, so engineers keep shipping

  • Grow every engineer through regular 1:1s, direct feedback and a personal growth path in our Career Progression Framework, with a development plan for each of them every year

  • Set the squad's technical direction and quality standards, and review code and architecture with enough depth to be genuinely useful while the team does the coding

  • Use AI in your own work with good judgement, set the example for the squad and help everyone adopt it while keeping quality and security high

  • Explain technical trade-offs clearly to Product, Design and stakeholders, including what the option you didn't pick would cost

  • Review delivery and reliability with the squad every week (DORA metrics, PR cycle time, uptime, incidents), balance roadmap work against tech debt, and take your turn in the on-call rotation

  • Help hire the people who join the squad, and help shape how the engineering department works beyond it

What you bring:

  • You have 6+ years in software engineering, with at least 2 of them managing engineers with direct reports

  • Your engineering background is senior-level, so you hold your own on code and architecture in a web stack

  • You're curious about users and why the squad builds what it builds. You've shaped a roadmap together with a PM and changed what got built because of something you learned from users or data

  • You've grown engineers to the next level and can point to the conversations, including the hard ones, that got them there

  • You balance empathy with directness: you build strong relationships and still say the hard thing. You stay steady under pressure and can hold an unpopular position when it matters

  • AI is already part of how you work, and you have a clear view on how to bring it into a team

  • You see skill gaps as teachable, in yourself and in every engineer, and you ask for feedback as readily as you give it

  • You get energy from a scale-up, even when it feels like building the plane while flying it, and you're comfortable with uncertainty and change

  • Experience with Ruby on Rails or Ember.js, EdTech or B2B SaaS used at scale, a tech-lead or product-engineer background, or setting up DORA/DX metrics and CI/CD all help, as does an affinity with education

  • Excellent written and spoken English, available full-time

What you get:

  • 25 paid holidays per year

  • A day off for your birthday

  • Advantageous pension scheme

  • 3 days of volunteering leave per year

  • €550 Learning & Development budget per year + 3 days paid leave for learning

  • Travel allowance and Swapfiets subscription

  • Free access to our office gym

  • Unlimited access to mental health support via OpenUp (EU, US, and AUS)

Compensation: €90K – €105K

  • • Annual base salary incl. 8% holiday allowance. Your offer within this range depends on your experience and interview performance: €90K – €105K

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Hi, I'm Maria, Interim VP Product at FeedbackFruits. 👋

FeedbackFruits is moving from a founder-led company to a product-led one, which means Product is taking on a much bigger role in deciding what we build and why. Before stepping into this role I worked as a PM here myself, with the squads and within the details, so I know how much depends on the PMs who work with those squads every day. I'm building a team of PMs who care about the craft: who do the discovery before committing to a build, make clear calls about priorities, and follow their work through to how teachers end up using it.

I'm looking for a Product Manager to lead one of our squads and own how teachers go from setting up their first activity to making FeedbackFruits part of how they teach every week. That means helping instructors see which students are stuck while there's still time to step in, making grading faster and less painful, and making it easy for a great activity to travel from one teacher to the next across an institution. You'll decide what the squad works on and why, and you'll have the room to set that direction yourself.

The EdTech market is tough right now, so every product decision has to earn its place. I like working this way, because a PM with sharp judgment sees their impact fast. You’ll also help shape how product works here as we raise the bar together: how we find the right problems, make calls and bring people along, and what great looks like for the PMs who join after you.

What you'll do:

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for your squad, and keep its work tied to what matters most to us right now: teachers getting value from FeedbackFruits early and coming back for more

  • Run discovery with teachers, institutions and partners, dig into the data, and frame each problem clearly before anyone starts designing a solution

  • Make the prioritisation calls, including the "not now"s, and explain them with enough context that people follow your reasoning even when they'd have chosen differently

  • Work side by side with engineers on technical approach and feasibility, and with designers on critiques and validating solutions with users

  • Write specs and acceptance criteria clear enough that the squad can move without waiting on you, then review what gets built and keep iterating

  • Define MVPs that get something useful into teachers' hands quickly, and after launch, look at the results and decide whether to scale it, rework it or retire it

  • Keep Sales, Partner Success and leadership aligned by documenting decisions, presenting strategy and progress, and keeping the roadmap visible

  • Help the squad see how its work lands with teachers and students, and make time to celebrate the wins

What you bring:

  • You have 3+ years of product management experience, and you've shipped B2B SaaS features that measurably changed how people use a product

  • You spot opportunities before anyone asks for them, and you'd rather spend an extra day understanding a problem than a month building the wrong solution

  • You can say "no" to a request and keep the relationship intact, because you back your reasoning with data and strategy

  • You write and speak with the kind of clarity that saves everyone a follow-up meeting. Your expectations are set before the work starts, and your feedback is direct

  • You understand how products are built technically, well enough to have a proper conversation with engineers about trade-offs. A technical or design background helps a lot here

  • You think big and ship small, and you know when to fight for quality and when "good enough for now" is the right call

  • You ask for feedback, take it without getting defensive, and change course when the evidence points somewhere new

  • You already use AI tools in your day-to-day work for research synthesis, analysis and documentation, and you're curious about where they can take the craft next

  • Experience in edtech, with LMS platforms like Canvas, Brightspace, Moodle or Blackboard, or with integrations and APIs gives you a head start

  • Available 40 hours per week, with 3 days a week from our Amsterdam office

What you get:

  • 25 paid holidays per year

  • Hybrid work schedule (3 days onsite)

  • A day off for your birthday

  • Advantageous pension scheme

  • 3 days of volunteering leave per year

  • €550 Learning & Development budget per year + 3 days paid leave for learning

  • Travel allowance and Swapfiets subscription

  • Free access to our office gym

  • Unlimited access to mental health support via OpenUp (EU, US, and AUS)

Compensation: €83K – €90K

  • • Annual base salary incl. 8% holiday allowance. Your offer within this range depends on your experience and interview performance: €83K – €90K
