jobs.title: Software Engineer - Ruby on Rails
jobs.description:
We're hiring a full-stack engineer to help us build the next version of FeedbackFruits.

  • We believe in engineers who stay close to the product: domain experts who pay attention to how users actually behave and use the platform.

  • Most of the work comes down to one thing: making the product better. We rethink each feature from the user's perspective and rebuild it on stronger foundations, together with our designers and product managers.

  • We modernise the stack as we go, moving from Rails + Ember.js to Rails + Hotwire. There's deeper technical work alongside it, on performance, stability, and the platform, all in service of a product that feels faster and more reliable.

  • Stabilisation and simplification are our top concerns, from both a product and an engineering standpoint. We'd rather fix root causes for the long term than patch symptoms, even when patching would be quicker.

  • Our long-term aim is to get closer to our users by shipping faster, moving from one monthly release with regular hotfixes toward continuous delivery.

  • We've also adopted agentic coding and integrations to sharpen how we work, and we value multipliers: engineers who raise the people around them and put the team before their own output.

What you'll do:

  • Join one of our engineering squads and own full-stack delivery on the roadmap, from backend logic and database design to the server-rendered UI it connects to

  • Lead the migration of Ember features to Rails + Hotwire, which means understanding the existing functionality, redesigning it thoughtfully together with PMs/designers, and shipping something better than what was there before

  • Handle support escalations and legacy bug-fixing as part of the mix alongside feature work. The balance will depend on which squad you join, but keeping the codebase healthy and customers unblocked is part of the job

  • Contribute to improving our CI/CD practices and deployment pipeline as we work toward more frequent, more reliable releases

  • Keep performance in mind across the stack

  • Build and maintain integrations with Learning Management Systems using LTI and partner APIs

  • Participate in code reviews and technical design discussions, bringing both quality standards and a pragmatist's sense of what's worth the effort

What you bring:

  • You have 3+ years of professional software engineering experience and Ruby on Rails is your home stack: you've shipped production code with it, you know its conventions, and you're comfortable in its edges

  • You write tests as a matter of course, not as an afterthought. RSpec and Capybara are part of your regular toolkit, and you write tests that actually catch things rather than just confirm the happy path

  • You are user-oriented: when you're deciding how a feature should work, your first instinct is to think about the person using it, not the implementation that's most convenient

  • You've worked in a legacy codebase before and come through it well. You know what to fix, what to leave, and how to leave things better than you found them without getting stuck in a refactoring spiral

  • You understand CI/CD well enough to work within good practices and to nudge a codebase toward them when they're missing

  • You communicate clearly, give honest feedback in code reviews, and take it just as well. You’re collaborative without needing everyone to agree with you

  • You are pragmatic and document your decisions; you'd rather make a thoughtful trade-off and write it down than chase the perfect solution indefinitely

  • Familiarity with Ember.js or migration scenarios from it to Hotwire is a genuine advantage here; experience with AI dev tooling, Azure, or observability practices would serve you well too

What you get:

  • Hybrid work schedule (3 days onsite)

  • 25 paid holidays per year

  • A day off for your birthday

  • Advantageous pension scheme

  • 3 days of volunteering leave per year

  • €550 Learning & Development budget per year + 3 days paid leave for learning

  • Travel allowance and Swapfiets subscription

  • Free access to our office gym

  • Unlimited access to mental health support via OpenUp (EU, US, and AUS)

Compensation: €60K – €75K

  • • Annual base salary incl. 8% holiday allowance. Your offer within this range depends on your experience and interview performance: €60K – €75K

jobs.title: Financial Administrator
jobs.description:
Hi, I'm Alex, Finance Manager at FeedbackFruits. 👋

Our Finance team is ramping up over the next couple of years, and we are looking for someone to join the team on a 24-32 hour basis! Finance here runs across two entities, a Dutch BV and a US Corp, each with its own invoicing, tax and banking rules. Our customers are universities all over the world, so the work ranges from a straightforward Dutch invoice to a US procurement portal with its own supplier onboarding forms and submission rules. The role is broader than most financial administration jobs at this level, and we are searching for someone who's ready to own it.

I'm looking for a Financial Administrator to take on our day-to-day operations: billing and collections on the receivables side, supplier invoices and payment runs on the payables side, and the Finance mailbox where everything is coordinated. A lot of our processes are still manual, with limited documented processes. You'd be doing the work and improving it at the same time, formalising operating procedures as you go. The ideal team member is someone who notices when a workflow is clumsy, and is proactive in addressing it.

We're a small team of two, and we support the wider organisation with a vast range of topics. You'd work closely with our New Business and Partner Success teams when it comes to billing, and with our Marketing team when it comes to purchasing. When an invoice goes out on time, a university pays on schedule or a purchasing inquiry is resolved ahead of an event, that's visible, and it will be thanks to you. Financial administration can often be limited to a narrow scope of topics within a larger team. If you're eager to get the full picture of operations in a company with an international customer base, this is the right place for it.

What you'll do:

  • Send out sales invoices on time. This includes setting up new customers and uploading invoices to procurement portals such as Ariba and PaymentWorks

  • Set up and maintain customer subscriptions in the ERP system based on signed contracts, and create invoices and credit notes for all legal entities

  • Keep track of unpaid invoices, send payment reminders to institutions that haven’t paid, and flag invoices that stay unpaid

  • Partner with Sales and Partner Success to address billing and payment queries

  • Ensure supplier invoices and expenses are processed on time

  • Prepare the weekly payment run for approval

  • Compare bank transactions with our accounting records and resolve any discrepancies

  • Manage the Finance mailbox: customer invoice and payment questions, supplier requests, supplier onboarding forms, and internal requests that come in through the ticketing system

  • Support month-end close and annual accounts

  • Write down how finance processes work in the Finance database in Notion, and update it when you improve them

What you bring:

  • You stay accurate and organised during busy periods. At month-end you keep daily work running smoothly while closing the month.

  • You follow things through to the end, in a friendly way. Late payments, missing details or an invoice that needs to match a contract: you stay on it until it’s sorted, and people enjoy working with you.

  • You take ownership of your work from start to finish. You plan your own week, set your own priorities and keep things moving.

  • You speak up when something in the numbers looks off, so we can fix it together.

  • You enjoy working with tools and software, and like finding new ways to get more out of them.

  • You’re comfortable building things as you go. You ask good questions, fill in the gaps and make sure you know the next steps before you start.

  • You have at least one year of experience in a finance or similar administrative role (two or more is a plus), including hands-on work with billing or subscriptions. We care more about your experience than your degree.

  • You’ve worked with an accounting system or ERP, such as Exact Online, NetSuite, Dynamics or SAP. Experience with Exact Online, Moss or procurement portals is a bonus

  • You write and speak English fluently, as we use it for all internal and external work.

  • You’re available 24 to 32 hours per week and can work from our Amsterdam office 2-3 days a week.

What you get:

  • 25 paid holidays per year, based on a 40-hour work week

  • Hybrid work schedule (2-3 days onsite)

  • A day off for your birthday

  • Advantageous pension scheme

  • 3 days of volunteering leave per year

  • €550 Learning & Development budget per year + 3 days paid leave for learning

jobs.title: Senior Product Analyst
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE 🌍

Creating content that resonates is great — turning that attention into growth is even better. That's what Manychat does.

Our AI-powered automations help creators and brands engage with audiences across Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, and TikTok — at the right moment, with the right message, minus the manual work.

We're 400+ people across three continents behind the leading platform for conversational growth, with AI skills shaping how we build, how we work, and how we grow.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 🌟

We're looking for a sharp, curious, and impact-driven Product Analyst to help us build products our customers love. You'll join the Product Analytics team at Manychat, working closely with Product, Design, and Engineering to bring data into every decision we make.This role is perfect for someone who loves turning data into quick action: zooming in to uncover the signal in the noise, and zooming out to see the big picture. If you thrive at the intersection of product thinking and data, excited about working in a fast-scaling SaaS product, and want to have a positive impact on the daily lives of more than one million creators, influencers, and brands, we'd love to meet you.

WHAT YOUʼLL DO 🚀

  • Drive insights that matter: Translate complex data into compelling stories that guide product decisions and strategy.

  • Shape success metrics and influence the roadmap: Partner with PMs to define KPIs, metric trees, and measurable goals that connect product impact to business outcomes. Surface insights that size opportunities, highlight trade-offs, and sharpen prioritization.

  • Guide experimentation: Design, run, and evaluate A/B tests.

  • Build trusted data: Collaborate with engineers and data teams to ensure reliable, scalable data models and tracking.

  • Make data accessible: Create dashboards, enable self-service, and drive data literacy across product teams.

TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE 💥

  • Experience: 4+ years in product analytics or similar area, ideally in SaaS or consumer-facing products.

  • Technical skills: Strong SQL and Python for data analysis; proficiency with BI tools (e.g. Tableau) is expected.

jobs.description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

About the role

You’ll grow a portfolio of our most important automotive OEM and supplier accounts in EMEA, working hand in hand with our Business Development leaders. Our deals are large, technical and multi-year. These deals are built on a foundation of understanding multiple technical and business stakeholders, from individual engineers, to leadership and C-suite. You will need to spend time understanding what an engineering team is battling, what the program manager is worried about, how to gain support and buy in from procurement and purchasing teams, and what the CTO is trying to achieve at a strategic level, then pull these threads together to build a successful deal. You'll work hand in hand with solution engineering and business development teams to shape, build and close deals. Internally, you’ll coordinate engineering, product, legal and finance to deliver on what we commit.

At Applied Intuition, you will:

  • Own critical client relationships and expand reach into key accounts including major OEM and Tier 1 relationships.

  • Drive strategic alignment and executive engagement across R&D, procurement and other relevant teams

  • Grow current footprint across Applied Intuition's solutions and land multi year commercial deals, including securing renewal risks

We're looking for someone who has:

  • Bachelor's degree

  • 5-10 years of experience automotive software / platform / semiconductor sales into Automotive OEMs

  • Track record of securing large scale, multi year software deals

  • Strong knowledge of a complex software sales process, including ability to map stakeholders, leverage key contacts and drive progress through legal, following up and maintaining CRM hygiene

Nice to have:

  • Technical fluency around Software Defined Vehicle technical topics, ADAS/AD, ADAS validation, SIL/HIL toolchains

  • Ability to have a technical conversation without the presence of a solution engineer

  • Strong network inside at least one or more major European Automotive OEMs

  • Masters in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or comparable Engineering subject

  • MBA

Compensation at Applied Intuition for eligible roles includes base salary, equity, and benefits. Base salary is a single component of the total compensation package, which may also include equity in the form of options and/or restricted stock units, comprehensive health, dental, vision, life and disability insurance coverage, 401k retirement benefits with employer match, learning and wellness stipends, and paid time off. Note that benefits are subject to change and may vary based on jurisdiction of employment.

The actual base salary offered to a successful candidate will additionally be influenced by a variety of factors including experience, credentials & certifications, educational attainment, skill level requirements, interview performance, and the level and scope of the position.

jobs.description:
About Virtual Identity

 

Virtual Identity (VI) is a digital agency built on Human-Centered Business Growth: combining empathy for people with insight from data to drive real digital success. With around 140 colleagues across Freiburg, Munich, Vienna, and Porto (and remote), we cover the full spectrum from Consulting and UX Research to UX/UI Design, Software Development, and Digital Marketing — always learning in close collaboration with our clients.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer at VI, you sit at the intersection of client, product, and engineering. You're not building in isolation from a backlog handed down by someone else — you go into deep, sustained virtual immersion with the client, understand their real operational problems, and ship working software that solves them, fast. You prototype, integrate, and iterate directly with the people who will use what you build, then help harden it into something production-ready with our delivery teams.

You also bring a well-founded understanding of agentic engineering — not just using AI coding assistants, but genuinely understanding how agents plan, use tools, and fail, and applying that thinking to how you build, integrate, and automate in the field.

This role suits someone who's equally comfortable in a client workshop, a codebase, and a data pipeline — and who gets energy from ambiguity rather than needing it resolved before starting.

 

What you will do:

  • Embed with client teams to observe workflows, diagnose bottlenecks, and identify where custom software can create outsized impact.

  • Rapidly prototype and deploy solutions — internal tools, integrations, automations, data pipelines — directly in the client's environment.

  • Translate messy, real-world requirements into working code without waiting for a fully specified brief.

  • Own the full loop: build, deploy, get feedback from actual users within days, iterate.

  • Use agentic engineering practices — not just AI-assisted coding, but designing workflows, automations, and integrations that leverage agents as a core part of the solution, where it genuinely helps the client.

  • Work closely with VI's UX, consulting, and cloud-native engineering teams to transition prototypes into scalable, supportable production systems.

  • Navigate client infrastructure, security constraints, and existing systems (cloud platforms, APIs, legacy tools) pragmatically.

  • Act as a trusted technical voice in client conversations — you can whiteboard an architecture and defend it in the same meeting.

  • Travel to client sites as needed (frequency depends on engagement).

    What we expect:

  • Strong full-stack or cloud-native engineering experience, with a track record of shipping real software, not just prototypes that die in a demo.

  • Comfort working directly with non-technical stakeholders and translating their problems into technical solutions on the fly.

  • Solid grounding in at least one modern backend stack and one frontend stack, plus working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

  • Experience with APIs, data integration, and automation — you can connect systems that were never designed to talk to each other.

  • Real, well-founded knowledge of agentic engineering — you understand the underlying concepts (agent planning, tool use, context management, orchestration, evaluation), not just the tool names, and you've applied that thinking to real work, not side projects.

  • A bias toward action: you'd rather build a rough version and test it with real users than perfect a spec.

  • Strong communication skills — you can explain a technical trade-off to a client stakeholder without jargon.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities; forward deployed work is inherently unstructured.

  • Willingness to travel to client sites.

  • Experience in an agency, consultancy, or client-facing technical role (nice to have).

  • Familiarity with UX research or design collaboration workflows (nice to have).

  • Exposure to enterprise integration patterns or legacy system modernization (nice to have).

  • Hands-on experience building or deploying agentic systems for a client, not just personal productivity use (nice to have).

  • A relevant degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field — but we care more about what you've built (nice to have).

What you can expect from us

 

Exciting projects with well-known brands, a team of motivated colleagues who genuinely enjoy working together, and continuous learning through our VI Academy. Whether you're based in one of our offices or working fully remote, we give you the room to grow — professionally and personally.

 

Sound like your kind of place? We'd love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Please apply with a CV in the English Language. This is a Paris-based role with global reach and therefore Fluency in French and English (both written and spoken) is important.

Role Summary

Checkout.com is seeking a talented and dynamic Legal Counsel with a strong French employment law background to join our Employment Legal team. This role will involve advising on the full spectrum of employment law issues across our French business and supporting broader global employment law initiatives, especially across other EMEA jurisdictions.

You will work closely with our People Team and key business stakeholders in France and internationally. This is a great opportunity to support and develop our French employment legal strategy while collaborating as part of a global team supporting employees across EMEA, APAC, and the Americas. You will take a consultative and commercial approach to handling complex Labor Code compliance matters, works council (CSE) consultations, litigation, employee relations, and strategic projects across France. You’ll also advise on individual and collective dismissals, restructurings, settlement negotiations, performance management, misconduct investigations and HR audits. You’ll monitor legal and regulatory developments across EMEA and provide proactive guidance on emerging risks and legal requirements. You’ll also help the employment legal team develop scalable processes, templates, and compliance frameworks, including through the use of AI tools.

You will be able to handle multiple areas of responsibilities autonomously, demonstrating excellent critical judgment with hands-on approach. You will report into our Associate General Counsel (Head of Employment) based in London. You will also work closely with the regional People Team leads, based in France and other EMEA jurisdictions.

You will be joining a high-achieving legal team in one of Europe's most valuable fintechs. Our mission is to be the best legal team in the world, providing pragmatic and commercially focused advice, finding creative solutions to manage risk and becoming trusted advisers to our colleagues in the business.

Essential Qualifications:

  • French qualified lawyer (Avocat admitted to the French Bar or Master 2 in French Employment Law / Droit du Travail)

  • 5+ years experience specializing in French employment law, either in a reputable law firm or in-house

  • Fluency in French and English (both written and spoken) with the ability to articulate complex legal issues clearly to non-French leadership.

  • Within a commutable distance from our Paris office and comfortable working in the office as necessary under our hybrid working policy (currently three days per week on scheduled office days).

Strong candidates will demonstrate the following:

  • Experience as in-house employment counsel, ideally in a large global business headquartered outside of France.

  • Extensive experience managing CSE consultations, collective negotiations, restructurings, and pre-litigation/settlement strategy in France.

  • Work with a high-growth technology or another fast-paced company.

  • Exceptional analytical and writing skills, with a business-centric focus on risk.

  • Excellent time management skills and experience managing a diverse workload and competing stakeholder demands.

  • Enthusiasm for new challenges and working with a range of different stakeholders.

  • Be a systemic thinker with proven abilities for process improvement and simplification, including AI.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity, constant change, and a fast-paced culture.

Role Type and Location

Your Mission:

As Senior Materials Engineer (all genders) you will lead material selection for the propulsion battery system of VÆRIDION's CS-23 all-electric aircraft. You will identify the best material for each application, from composites and metals to adhesives, gaskets, and insulation materials, and own the material requirements and evidence that support each choice. Through trade studies, characterization, and close supplier engagement, you will make sure that every material in the propulsion battery system performs safely in normal operation, under abuse, and during thermal runaway.

Within the Mechanical Design & Integration team, you will work closely with Mechanical Design and Materials & Processes, and support the Thermal Systems, HV Electrical Systems, Airborne Electronics, and Cell Technology teams wherever material choices matter, including thermal adhesives, electrical bonding, and insulation. As development matures, you will hand over qualification and process ownership to Materials & Processes while remaining the technical authority on material behaviour. Your work will directly contribute to the propulsion battery system that underpins VÆRIDION's mission to bring electric flight to regional aviation.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Lead material selection for the propulsion battery system, including composites, metals, adhesives, gaskets, seals, potting compounds, and thermal and electrical insulation materials.

  • Lead structured material trade studies that balance mechanical, thermal, electrical, chemical, weight, cost, and supply chain considerations.

  • Own material requirements for normal operation, abuse, and failure cases, including thermal runaway, fire, venting, crash, vibration, humidity, and fluid exposure.

  • Evaluate high-temperature and fire protection materials, such as phenolic and high-char-yield composites, silicone systems, ceramics, and intumescent materials, for thermal runaway containment.

jobs.title: Senior AI Solutions Engineer (m/w/d)- Beratung und Umsetzung im Mittelstand
jobs.description:
Du verstehst KI-Systeme bis ins Detail. Und Du kannst sie einem Geschäftsführer so erklären, dass er die richtige Entscheidung trifft.

Wir wollen die KI-Expert:innen im Mittelstand sein. Nicht die, die am lautesten über KI reden, sondern die, die wissen, warum ein RAG-System schlechte Antworten liefert, welches Modell lokal betrieben werden kann und welcher Use Case in drei Monaten Wirkung zeigt. Dafür suchen wir Menschen, die beides mitbringen: echte technische Tiefe und Erfahrung darin, Kunden durch Projekte zu führen.

Als Senior AI Solutions Engineer bei Neurawork verantwortest Du Kundenprojekte von der ersten Analyse bis zum Go-live. Du nimmst Prozesse und Datenlage auf, bewertest Use Cases auf Machbarkeit und Wirkung, entwirfst die Architektur und setzt die Lösung selbst um, auf Basis unserer standardisierten Produkte und bis zur vollständigen Integration in die Systemlandschaft des Kunden. Der Kunde vertraut Dir, weil Du technisch weißt, wovon Du sprichst.

Wir arbeiten nach unserem eigenen Operational-AI-Vorgehensmodell. Wir sind keine Automation-Agentur und keine Custom-Softwareentwickler: Standardisierte Produkte sind unser Hebel, und wir passen sie bis zur vollständigen Integration an. Wir schaffen echten, messbaren Mehrwert und stehen dafür ein.

Aufgaben

Was Du bei uns machst

  • Projekte verantworten: Kundenprojekte im Mittelstand führen, vom Kick-off bis zur Übergabe in den Betrieb

  • Bewerten: Prozesse und Daten beim Kunden verstehen, Use Cases auf Machbarkeit, Kosten und Grenzen prüfen und nach Wirkung priorisieren

  • Selbst bauen: Architektur entwerfen, unsere Produkte konfigurieren und erweitern, Retrieval und Prompting optimieren, Qualität messbar machen

  • Integrieren: Schnittstellen, Datenanbindung, Sicherheit und Betrieb gemeinsam mit der Kunden-IT umsetzen

  • Beraten mit Substanz: Fachabteilung, IT und Geschäftsführung fundiert begleiten, Erwartungen klar steuern, Roadmaps entwickeln, die technisch tragen

  • Menschen mitnehmen: Workshops moderieren und Teilnehmende befähigen, damit die Lösung im Alltag ankommt

  • Weitergeben: Erkenntnisse in unsere Frameworks und Produkte zurückspielen; Live-Sessions in unserer KI-Ausbildung mit TÜV Süd Zertifikat und im KI-Business-Coaching

Nicht passend für Dich, wenn...

Nicht passend für Dich, wenn …

  • Du KI-Projekte bisher gesteuert oder begleitet, aber nicht selbst technisch umgesetzt hast,

  • Deine KI-Systeme ausschließlich mit No-Code-Tools entstanden sind,

  • Du am liebsten nur im Code bleibst und Kundentermine, Workshops oder Gespräche mit der Geschäftsführung lieber anderen überlässt

Qualifikation

Was Du mitbringst

Technisches Fundament:

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium im MINT-Bereich (z. B. Informatik, Mathematik, Physik, Ingenieurwissenschaften, Data Science). Alternativ mehrere Jahre professionelle Softwareentwicklung. Zertifikatskurse und Weiterbildungen ersetzen das nicht.

  • Mindestens ein KI-System, das Du selbst konzipiert und umgesetzt hast und zeigen kannst, z. B. eine RAG-Pipeline, einen produktiven Agenten oder eine technisch verantwortete Automatisierung

  • Du programmierst sicher (z. B. Python) und arbeitest mit APIs, Datenbanken und Deployment. Reine No-Code- oder Low-Code-Erfahrung reicht für diese Rolle nicht.

  • Du kannst technische Entscheidungen begründen, z. B. warum Du ein Modell, eine Chunking-Strategie oder einen Cloud- statt lokalen Betrieb gewählt hast und wo deren Grenzen liegen

Beratungserfahrung:

  • 4+ Jahre Berufserfahrung, davon mindestens 2 Jahre mit direktem Kundenkontakt in technischen Projekten, z. B. als Technical Consultant, Solutions Engineer, Solution Architect, Data-/AI-Consultant, technische Projektleitung oder Freelancer mit eigenen Kunden. Interne Fachbereiche als Kunden zählen auch.

  • Du hast Anforderungen aufgenommen, Workshops moderiert und Entscheidungen bei Stakeholdern herbeigeführt, auch auf Geschäftsführungsebene

  • Du kannst einem Kunden sagen, dass sein Wunsch-Use-Case keinen Sinn ergibt, und ihm eine bessere Alternative zeigen

Außerdem wichtig:

  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (C2) in Wort und Schrift

  • Gutes Englisch, Wohnsitz in Deutschland und Bereitschaft zu Kundenterminen vor Ort

Was wir bieten

  • Projektverantwortung ab dem ersten Mandat, ohne Layer über Dir; direkter Draht zum Founding-Team

  • Beide Welten in einer Rolle: selbst bauen und selbst beraten, ohne Übergaben zwischen Beratung und Entwicklung

  • Ein Team, das technisch auf Augenhöhe diskutiert: Austausch mit der KI-Elite in Deutschland

  • Framework-driven statt ad hoc, und Du gestaltest die Frameworks mit

  • Wert statt Stunden: Uns zählen Ergebnisse, nicht Tagessätze

  • Moderner Tech-Stack und Raum zum Experimentieren

  • Sichtbarkeit als Expertise über unsere KI-Business-Coaching-Community und die TÜV-SÜD-Kooperation

  • Voll-remote möglich; Teamtage und Kundenworkshops vor Ort, üblicherweise 2–4 Tage im Monat im DACH-Raum

Bewerbung: Bring Dein Projekt mit!

Schick uns Deinen Lebenslauf und beantworte kurz zwei Fragen:

  1. Dein Projekt (3–5 Sätze): Welches KI-System würdest Du uns im Zweitgespräch zeigen? Was löst es, wie ist es aufgebaut, welchen Teil hast Du selbst umgesetzt, und welche technische Entscheidung hast Du dabei bewusst getroffen? Ein Link zu GitHub, einem Demo-Video o. Ä. ist willkommen.

  2. Dein Kunde (2–3 Sätze): Beschreib eine Situation, in der Du einen Kunden oder Fachbereich von einer technischen Entscheidung überzeugt oder seine Erwartungen korrigiert hast. Was war die Ausgangslage, was hast Du getan, was kam heraus?

Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich, Dein Projekt und Deine Kundengeschichte kennenzulernen!

Samsara is a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $1.9B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. This is a seat built for high performers and incredibly driven individuals who want to accelerate their careers — the bar for entry is high, but those who execute are well rewarded for it.

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role you will:

  • Own your destiny: Operate as a pure revenue leader, responsible for 80-90% net-new logo acquisition through self-sourced pipeline.
  • Get In Early: The France Mid-Market is a high-achieving segment in the company. The window to build something significant is open right now. 
  • Sharpen Your Edge: Access elite enablement — Command the Message and MEDDPICC coaching — built to make you a more effective closer.
  • Navigate Complexity: Move beyond feature-pushing to sell high-level ROI and safety outcomes to sophisticated economic buyers (MDs and FDs) in the field and the boardroom.

Minimum requirements for this role:

  • The Winning DNA: A minimum of 18 months in a full-cycle, outbound-heavy SaaS closing role. You must have a proven history of building your own pipe from scratch.
  • Verified Overachievement: A track record of hitting and exceeding quota in a competitive, complex environment. We'll want to see this on your resume. 
  • Strategic Grit: Experience managing multi-stakeholder deal cycles and technical POCs. We value your ability to hunt more than the brand name on your previous CV.
  • Native French language

An ideal candidate also offers:

  • Intellectual Curiosity: You are eager to learn the inner workings of diverse industries, from waste management to food distribution, to better align our technology with their operational pain.
  • A Repeatable Sales Framework: You don't rely on luck or intuition. You have a structured methodology that delivers success and you understand that consistent, high-quality inputs lead to predictable results.
  • A Data-Minded Approach: You are a student of your own funnel. You understand how to structure your activity—prospecting volume, discovery depth, and multi-threading—to ensure a consistent output and forecast accuracy.
  • Continuous Process Iteration: You possess a relentless drive for self-improvement. You are someone who actively seeks feedback, iterates on their approach, and understands that evolving your tactics is the only way to stay ahead of the market.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

jobs.description:
Über die Nord-Ostsee Sparkasse

Wie schön, dass du dich für uns als Arbeitgeber interessierst. Wir sind eine der größten Sparkassen Deutschlands mit 40 Filialen und einer Bilanzsumme von über 8 Mrd. Euro. Als Marktführerin in unserer Region engagieren wir uns für vielfältige gesellschaftliche Projekte und wurden mehrfach als beliebteste Bank ausgezeichnet. Doch was uns vor allem antreibt, sind die Zufriedenheit unserer 270.000 Kundinnen und Kunden und das Wohlbefinden unserer über 800 Mitarbeitenden. Bei uns erwarten dich Teamwork, interessante Jobprofile, vielfältige Entwicklungswege und ein sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einer der schönsten Regionen Deutschlands. Du hast Lust uns kennenzulernen? Dann bewirb dich jetzt. Wir sind mehr als nur ein Arbeitgeber. Wir sind Sparkasse.


Deine Mission:

Du möchtest nicht nur Zahlen analysieren, sondern daraus konkrete Impulse für den Vertrieb ableiten? Du interessierst dich dafür, wie aus der Unternehmensstrategie konkrete Ziele für Produkte, Kundensegmente und Vertriebseinheiten entstehen?

Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!

In dieser verantwortungsvollen Position verbindest du strategisches Denken mit operativer Umsetzung und entwickelst den Vertrieb zukunftsorientiert weiter. Du hast Markt und Kund:innen im Blick, erkennst Chancen frühzeitig und sorgst dafür, dass aus strategischen Ideen konkrete Maßnahmen werden.

Folgende Aufgaben warten auf dich:

Du entwickelst die strategische sowie operative Produkt- und Geschäftsfeldplanung auf Basis der Unternehmensplanung und übersetzt strategische Zielsetzungen in konkrete Ziele.

Du entwickelst Vertriebsstrategien kontinuierlich weiter und setzt neue Impulse – auf Basis der Geschäftsstrategie sowie aktueller und zukünftiger Marktentwicklungen.

Du leitest daraus Zielgruppen-, Produkt- und Kommunikationsstrategien ab und entwickelst passende Ansätze für unsere Marktbearbeitung.

Du übersetzt interne und externe Anforderungen in eine ganzheitliche, omnikanale Vertriebsstrategie und sorgst dafür, dass diese in der Praxis ankommt.

Du hast unsere Vertriebsziele im Blick und entwickelst gemeinsam mit den relevanten Bereichen aussagekräftige KPIs und Messgrößen, mit denen der Vertrieb gezielt gesteuert und weiterentwickelt wird.

Du bringst den Vertrieb operativ weiter und übernimmst die verantwortliche Planung und Umsetzung vertrieblicher Projekte.

Als Schnittstelle zu Verbänden, externen Partnern und weiteren Stakeholdern arbeitest du an zentralen Umsetzungsthemen mit.

Du führst Markt-, Abweichungs- und Ursachenanalysen durch und interpretierst die Ergebnisse und entwickelst konkrete, passgenaue Maßnahmen für das Haus.

Deine Fähigkeiten:

Du zeichnest dich durch eine analytische, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise aus – vor allem aber hast du Freude daran, komplexe Zusammenhänge zu durchdringen und auf den Punkt zu bringen.

einem erfolgreich abgeschlossenen Studium als Sparkassen-/Bankbetriebswirt/in oder Bachelor mit mehrjähriger Erfahrung im Vertriebsmanagement oder -controlling oder einer vergleichbaren Funktion.

einem sehr guten Verständnis für betriebswirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge und die Steuerungslogik eines Kreditinstituts.

Erfahrung im Umgang mit Kennzahlen, Datenanalysen und Managementreports.

MS-Excel-Kenntnissen und idealerweise Erfahrung mit BI-, Reporting- oder Dashboard-Lösungen sowie Powerpoint und think-cell.

sicherer und adressatengerechter Kommunikation - auf allen Ebenen und agierst als kompetenter interner und externer Ansprechpartner.

jobs.description:
Qui sommes-nous ?
KAISCHOOL est une école supérieure spécialisée en Intelligence Artificielle, Data, Cybersécurité et Commerce IT. Elle forme du Bac+3 au Bac+5 en alternance, en mode hybride. Pour développer ses activités data, KAISCHOOL recrute un(e) alternant(e) Expert en Ingénierie des Données. Vous travaillerez sur nos propres projets et préparerez votre diplôme dans notre école.

Votre formation : Expert en infrastructure de données massives (Bac+5)
Il s’agit d’une certification de niveau 7 (Bac+5), enregistrée au RNCP sous le n° 37638 et délivrée par Simplon. Elle forme des experts capables de concevoir, déployer et gouverner des systèmes de données à grande échelle. La formation couvre toute la chaîne, de l’étude de faisabilité jusqu’au data warehouse et au data lake.

Vous apprendrez à :

  • concevoir et administrer des infrastructures de données massives ;

  • construire des pipelines de collecte, de traitement et de distribution des données ;

  • créer et maintenir des entrepôts de données et des data lakes ;

  • industrialiser les traitements avec CI/CD et DevOps Data ;

  • déployer sur des environnements cloud public, privé, multicloud ou on-premise ;

  • assurer la qualité, la sécurité et la conformité RGPD des données ;

  • piloter un projet data de bout en bout.

Technologies : Python, SQL, Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, Elasticsearch, Kubernetes, cloud.

Les + de KAISCHOOL :

  • formation 100 % gratuite pour vous, financée par l’OPCO, et salaire versé pendant toute l’alternance ;

  • pédagogie hybride : cours sur place à Fontenay-sous-Bois et plateforme en ligne avec replays 24h/24 ;

  • 15 projets concrets par étudiant ;

  • plus de 30 docteurs (PhD) en IA parmi les intervenants ;

  • école certifiée Qualiopi ;

  • 95 % d’insertion à 6 mois (promotion 2024, donnée déclarative de l’école).

Vos missions :

  • participer à la conception et à l’évolution de notre architecture de données ;

  • développer et maintenir des pipelines d’ingestion et de transformation (ETL/ELT) ;

  • intégrer des données venant de sources variées : CRM, plateformes pédagogiques, outils internes ;

  • contribuer à la mise en place et à l’alimentation d’un entrepôt de données ;

  • contrôler la qualité des données et surveiller les flux ;

  • automatiser les traitements et participer au déploiement cloud ;

  • documenter les jeux de données, les flux et les procédures ;

  • travailler avec les équipes métiers et data pour mettre les données à leur disposition.

jobs.title: AI Platform Engineer (m/w/d) | AI Hub für 10+ Unternehmen
jobs.description:
Über CHAPTERS Group

CHAPTERS Group ist eine börsennotierte deutsche Holding, die vertikale Softwareunternehmen erwirbt und hält. In den letzten fünf Jahren sind wir um das Zehnfache gewachsen und besitzen heute mehr als 60 Unternehmen. Jedes führt sein eigenes Geschäft, nah an seinen Kunden. Wir machen sie stärker, ohne ihnen das Steuer aus der Hand zu nehmen. KI ist eine der größten Chancen, die wir für sie sehen. Sie wirkt aber nur, wenn die Menschen in diesen Unternehmen sie auch nutzen.

Die Rolle

Du bist Teil des AI Core Teams im Office des CTO und arbeitest als Forward Deployed Engineer nah an den Unternehmen unserer Gruppe. Du betreibst unseren AI Hub, eine Open WebUI-basierte KI-Plattform, für mehr als 10 Unternehmen. Du bringst mit, was du im Feld siehst, testest neue Fähigkeiten und gestaltest die Plattform für alle 60+ Unternehmen mit.

Deutsch (C1+) und Englisch sind Pflicht.

Was du machst

  • Den AI Hub für 10+ Unternehmen betreiben: Deployments, Updates, Konfiguration, SSO mit Entra ID, Monitoring, Backups und Incident Handling

  • Unternehmen und Teams onboarden: Skills, Knowledge Bases und Tools einrichten, damit jedes Unternehmen produktiv mit dem Hub arbeitet

  • Technische Ansprechperson sein: Wenn etwas ausfällt oder ein Champion nicht weiterkommt, analysierst und behebst du das. Wiederkehrende Probleme dokumentierst du, damit sie nur einmal gelöst werden müssen.

  • Den Hub anbinden, wo ein Use Case es braucht: Microsoft 365 / Graph, CRM, Ticketing und ERP-Systeme über Tools, MCP-Server und REST-APIs

  • Wiederkehrende Fragen in wiederverwendbare Bausteine verwandeln: Dokumentation, Vorlagen und kurze Hands-on-Sessions

  • Im AI Core Team arbeiten: Muster über Unternehmen hinweg teilen, neue Features testen und Erkenntnisse in die Plattform-Roadmap einspeisen

  • Gelegentlich das M&A-Team unterstützen (etwa 10 bis 20 % deiner Zeit) bei technischen Fragen, zum Beispiel bei der Bewertung des Tech- und AI-Stacks von Übernahmekandidaten

Das bringst du mit

Pflicht

  • Deutsch (C1 oder höher) und fließend Englisch. Du arbeitest täglich auf Deutsch mit Geschäftsführern und nicht-technischen Teams. Hier machen wir keine Ausnahmen.

  • Erfahrung im Produktivbetrieb. Du hast containerisierte Anwendungen produktiv deployt und betrieben (Docker, CI/CD, Linux, eine große Cloud, Azure bevorzugt) und warst verantwortlich, wenn sie ausgefallen sind. Das heißt meist mindestens 2 Jahre in einer DevOps-, Platform-, SRE- oder Backend-Rolle.

  • Python, das du sicher lesen, debuggen und erweitern kannst

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit LLMs. Du nutzt sie im eigenen Arbeitsalltag ernsthaft, hast beruflich oder privat etwas damit gebaut und weißt, wo sie scheitern.

  • Du erklärst Technik so, dass Nicht-Techniker sie verstehen und danach handeln können. Du bist gern die technische Ansprechperson für Teams ohne technischen Hintergrund.

Starke Signale

  • Enterprise Identity: Entra ID, OAuth, SSO

  • Selbst gehostete LLM-Plattformen wie Open WebUI oder LibreChat

  • MCP, Tool Calling, Agent-Frameworks

  • Infrastructure as Code (Bicep, Terraform)

  • Erfahrung in einer Support-, Solutions- oder kundennahen technischen Rolle

  • Erfahrung in der Arbeit über mehrere Unternehmen, Tenants oder eine Gruppenstruktur hinweg

Diese Rolle ist nichts für dich, wenn du

  • den Großteil deiner Zeit damit verbringen willst, neue AI-Produkte von Grund auf zu bauen

  • ML-Forschung oder Modelltraining suchst

  • nur mit Engineers arbeiten und direkten Kontakt mit Fachbereichen vermeiden willst

Das bekommst du

  • Echte Verantwortung: 10+ Unternehmen, eine Plattform, und du sorgst dafür, dass KI dort funktioniert

  • Ein kleines AI Core Team mit direktem Draht zum C-Level. Entscheidungen fallen schnell.

  • Wirkung über deine Plattform hinaus: Was in deinen Unternehmen funktioniert, wird Standard für 55+

  • Unbefristete Vollzeitstelle, Remote-first mit gelegentlichen Präsenzterminen

  • Entwicklung: Talent Reviews, Events und Konferenzen. Wir stellen Leute ein, die mit uns wachsen wollen.

So bewirbst du dich

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und beantworte diese eine Frage auf Deutsch, maximal 200 Wörter. Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht.

  1. Erzähl uns von einem System, das du produktiv betrieben hast und das ausgefallen ist. Was ist passiert, was hast du getan, und was hat sich danach geändert?

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

jobs.title: Ingénieur Sécurité des Procédés - Process Safety Engineer (H/F)
jobs.description:
📜 Contexte

Dans le cadre du renforcement de l'équipe Sécurité des Procédés d'un site industriel situé à Genève, Suisse, nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur(e) Sécurité des Procédés (H/F) afin de contribuer à la maîtrise des risques liés aux procédés chimiques et à la sécurité des opérations industrielles.

Rattaché(e) au Département HSE / Sécurité des Procédés, vous évoluerez dans un environnement industriel exigeant et apporterez un support technique aux équipes de Production, de Maintenance et d'Ingénierie.

Votre rôle sera axé sur la prévention des accidents majeurs, la conformité aux standards et réglementations applicables, ainsi que l'amélioration continue de la performance sécurité des procédés du site.

📌 Votre rôle

En tant qu'Ingénieur(e) Sécurité des Procédés, vous interviendrez comme expert(e) technique sur l'ensemble des sujets liés à la sécurité des procédés.

Vous contribuerez à l'identification, à l'évaluation et à la maîtrise des risques procédés sur les installations existantes, les modifications techniques et les nouveaux projets.

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes EHS, Ingénierie, Production et Maintenance, ainsi qu'avec des interlocuteurs externes et les autorités locales lorsque nécessaire.

Vos missions

🎯 Responsabilités

🔹 Analyse des risques procédés
• Réaliser et mettre à jour les analyses de risques procédés, notamment les études HAZOP, What-If et LOPA.
• Identifier les scénarios de risques potentiels et recommander les mesures de prévention et de protection adaptées.
• Contribuer aux études de sécurité des installations existantes et des nouveaux projets.

🔹 Sécurité thermique & analyse technique
• Interpréter les résultats d'essais de sécurité thermique tels que DSC, C80 et RC1.
• Identifier des solutions concrètes pour maîtriser les risques liés aux réactions chimiques et aux procédés industriels.
• Analyser des données techniques complexes et formuler des recommandations claires.

🔹 Ingénierie & projets industriels
• Participer aux revues de conception des équipements et des installations industrielles.
• Contribuer aux projets d'investissement et aux modifications d'installations sous l'angle de la sécurité des procédés.
• Veiller à la prise en compte des exigences de sécurité tout au long de la conception.

🔹 Gestion du changement & conformité
• Participer aux processus de gestion du changement (MOC).
• Évaluer l'impact sécurité procédés des modifications techniques et vérifier leur conformité aux exigences applicables.
• Soutenir la mise en œuvre et le suivi des standards de sécurité des procédés conformément à la politique EHS de l'entreprise.

🔹 Support aux opérations & à la maintenance
• Apporter un support technique aux équipes d'exploitation et de maintenance sur les sujets de sécurité des procédés.
• Apporter votre expertise sur des thématiques telles que l'inertage, les pressions, les températures et les compatibilités chimiques.
• Accompagner les équipes dans la mise en œuvre des bonnes pratiques de sécurité des procédés.

🔹 Audits, réglementation & études de sécurité
• Participer aux audits et inspections de conformité réglementaire.
• Contribuer aux analyses quantitatives des risques (QRA), aux études de protection contre les explosions et aux autres évaluations de sécurité.
• Veiller au respect des standards et réglementations applicables en matière de sécurité des procédés.

🔹 Formation & sensibilisation
• Former et sensibiliser le personnel aux principes et bonnes pratiques de sécurité des procédés.
• Promouvoir une culture forte de la sécurité des procédés sur le site.
• Communiquer les exigences réglementaires et techniques aux interlocuteurs concernés.

Vos compétences

💼 Votre profil

• Diplôme d'ingénieur ou Master en génie chimique, chimie ou domaine équivalent.
• Minimum 5 ans d'expérience en sécurité des procédés dans un environnement industriel chimique ou pharmaceutique.
• Expérience confirmée dans la réalisation d'études de sécurité des procédés.
• Maîtrise des méthodologies HAZOP, LOPA, SIL et ATEX.
• Bonne connaissance des standards internationaux de sécurité des procédés tels que API, CCPS, IEC 61511 et SEVESO.
• Capacité à lire et interpréter des P&ID, schémas de procédé et spécifications d'équipements.
• Fortes capacités d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes, avec l'aptitude à synthétiser des informations techniques complexes.
• Excellentes qualités de communication et capacités pédagogiques.
• Esprit d'équipe, proactivité et autonomie.
• Français courant et bon anglais technique, notamment pour la lecture et la rédaction de documents HSE internationaux.

Avantages

🏆 Conditions du poste

• 📍 Lieu : Genève, Suisse
• 🕒 Taux d'activité : 100 %
• 📅 Date de démarrage : flexible, à convenir

⚠️ Ce poste est ouvert aux candidat(e)s de nationalité suisse ou européenne (UE/AELE), ou titulaires d'un permis de travail valable pour la Suisse.

Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Engineering Manager

Location: Remote - Europe (CET ±2 hours)

About FullEnrich:

Every go-to-market motion runs on data, but no single provider has ever had complete coverage. We solve that problem: instead of relying on a single data source, we orchestrate 20+ premium providers around the world, automatically querying them and verifying data in real-time until we find the best available contact information. The result is industry-leading coverage and data quality, helping sales and GTM teams connect with the right people faster.

What started as a better way to find emails and phone numbers has grown into a broader vision: becoming the trusted GTM data infrastructure layer powering modern revenue teams and AI agents. Today, more than 6,000 customers, including companies like AWS, Deel, HubSpot, Clay, Intercom, Unify,and Artisan, trust us to power their prospecting and enrichment.

Founded in Paris and now headquartered in San Francisco, we're a team of 50+ people across the US, Europe, LATAM, and Israel, growing quickly and building with speed, ownership, and ambition. That's where you come in.

The Role:

You'll be joining as an Engineering Manager, reporting directly to our VP of Engineering.

As FullEnrich continues to grow, we're investing in the engineering leadership and structure needed to support our next stage of growth. We're looking for someone who combines strong people leadership with technical depth, and who enjoys building high-performing teams, improving how engineers work, and creating the foundations for sustainable growth.

You'll initially lead a multidisciplinary team of up to ten engineers across backend, frontend, and data, taking ownership of their development, performance, and delivery. Working closely with Product Managers and engineering leadership, you'll help translate business priorities into achievable engineering objectives, ensuring teams have the clarity, support, and processes they need to deliver great work.

This is an opportunity to have a real impact on how our engineering organization evolves. As we scale toward 25 engineers, you'll help shape our squad structure, establish effective ways of working, and build an environment where engineers can grow and do their best work. You'll work closely with the VP of Engineering, CTO, and other Engineering Managers, with the autonomy to influence decisions and drive meaningful improvements across the organization.

What You'll Do:

People Leadership & Development

  • Lead, coach, and develop engineers through regular 1:1s, performance management, feedback, and career development.

  • Build a supportive, high-performing team environment where engineers have clear expectations, opportunities to grow, and the autonomy to do their best work.

  • Take ownership of team health, engagement, and retention, proactively identifying and addressing challenges.

Hiring & Team Growth

  • Own the engineering side of hiring for your squads, including defining requirements, setting assessment criteria, interviewing, and making hiring decisions.

  • Develop effective onboarding processes that help new engineers become productive and autonomous quickly.

  • Partner with engineering leadership to shape team structure, squad ownership, and hiring priorities as the organization scales.

Engineering Delivery & Execution

  • Partner with Product Managers to translate product and business priorities into clear engineering objectives, realistic roadmaps, and measurable outcomes.

  • Own engineering delivery across your squads, ensuring work is appropriately scoped, estimated, and delivered with clear accountability.

  • Identify and manage delivery risks, technical dependencies, and competing priorities, keeping stakeholders informed and addressing blockers early.

Engineering Processes & Continuous Improvement

  • Own and continuously improve how your squads operate, using our Discovery → Run lifecycle, inspired by Shape Up, and DORA metrics to measure delivery effectiveness.

  • Establish practical, scalable ways of working that improve predictability, collaboration, and engineering quality without introducing unnecessary bureaucracy.

  • Collaborate with other Engineering Managers and the VP of Engineering to evaluate and improve engineering processes across the wider organization.

Technical Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Provide technical guidance on architectural decisions, engineering trade-offs, and complex delivery challenges, ensuring teams make well-informed decisions.

  • Work closely with Product, Design, Support, Sales, and leadership to align engineering priorities with business needs.

  • Communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs clearly, creating transparency and trust across teams and stakeholders.

Our Tech Stack

Our backend is built in Go (Golang), with Svelte on the frontend, PostgreSQL and OpenSearch for data, and DigitalOcean for cloud infrastructure. We use Docker, GitHub Actions, and Grafana to support deployment, automation, and observability, with a modular hexagonal monolith architecture.

You won't need to be hands-on with every technology, but you'll bring the technical understanding to challenge architectural decisions, navigate trade-offs, and support your engineers in solving complex problems.

What Success Looks Like:

By 3 months

  • You've built a strong understanding of our product, technology, engineering processes, and business objectives, establishing trusted relationships with your engineers and key stakeholders.

  • You've taken ownership of people management across your squads, with regular 1:1s, clear expectations, and an understanding of each engineer's strengths and development needs.

  • You've assessed current delivery practices, team structure, and performance, identifying opportunities to improve collaboration, predictability, and team effectiveness.

By 6 months

  • Your squads are operating with clear objectives, defined ownership, and measurable KPIs aligned with product and business priorities.

  • You've established effective delivery practices, with more predictable planning, proactive risk management, and improved visibility for stakeholders.

  • You've identified team capability gaps and are actively contributing to hiring, onboarding, and the development of engineers across your squads.

  • You're contributing meaningful improvements to engineering processes and organizational structure alongside the wider engineering management team.

By 12 months

  • Your squads consistently deliver against realistic, well-defined roadmaps, with clear accountability, effective collaboration, and measurable improvements in delivery performance.

  • Engineers have clear development paths, receive regular feedback, and feel supported in their growth, contributing to strong engagement and retention.

  • New engineers are onboarding efficiently and becoming productive quickly, supported by established processes and a clear engineering hiring bar.

  • You've helped shape a scalable engineering organization with well-defined squad ownership, effective ways of working, and stronger alignment between Engineering, Product, and the wider business.

  • Stakeholders have confidence in engineering delivery, with transparent communication, reliable planning, and fewer unexpected blockers.

What We're Looking For:

  • Proven experience directly managing and developing software engineers, ideally eight or more across multiple teams, within a growing engineering organization.

  • Demonstrated experience building or scaling engineering teams, including hiring, onboarding, performance management, and supporting engineers' career development.

  • A strong software engineering background with solid architectural fundamentals, enabling you to challenge technical decisions, understand trade-offs, and provide credible guidance.

  • Experience owning engineering delivery, translating product and business objectives into actionable plans, managing dependencies, and driving measurable outcomes.

  • A data-driven approach to engineering management, with experience using delivery metrics and team performance insights to identify and implement improvements.

  • The ability to establish effective engineering processes and ways of working that improve team performance without introducing unnecessary complexity.

  • Strong leadership and organizational skills, with the confidence to create structure, navigate ambiguity, and influence decisions in a scaling environment.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with experience collaborating effectively across distributed teams and cross-functional stakeholders.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience working with Go (Golang) or managing teams building Go-based applications.

  • Familiarity with Shape Up or similar appetite-driven development methodologies.

  • Experience using DORA metrics to measure and improve engineering delivery.

  • Knowledge of Team Topologies and experience shaping squad structures as engineering teams scale.

  • Experience scaling an engineering organization from approximately 10 to 25 engineers.

  • Background in B2B SaaS, data-intensive products, or API-first platforms.

The Hiring Process:

  • Introduction to FullEnrich with our Talent Team (30 mins) - A chance to learn more about you, introduce FullEnrich and the role, and explore whether there's a mutual fit.

  • Interview with the Hiring Manager (45 mins) - A chance for you to meet our VP of Engineering and walk through your background, the teams you've led, what you've built and broken along the way.

  • Engineering management case study (60 mins) - A practical session grounded in a real situation: a hiring decision, a delivery slipping, a process that isn't being followed, a performance conversation.

  • Final Interview with our CEO (45 min) – A chance for you to meet our CEO, Ben and have a conversation around FullEnrich's ambitions, how we work and what we're building together.

Benefits:

Your benefits package will reflect the requirements and market practices of the country in which you're employed, including applicable leave, healthcare, retirement and wellbeing benefits.

Full details will be shared during the hiring process.

FullEnrich is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, national origin, protected veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

Deputy MLRO (AML Compliance)

About Us

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 127 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building.

Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human.

Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page https://international.nubank.com.br/careers/

About the role

Nu Global AG is Nu's Swiss entity, based in Zug. It went live in October 2026 with its AML/CFT and sanctions framework already in place: entity risk analysis, internal directives, customer risk classification, monitoring and screening standards, and MROS reporting. The same team also drives the next steps of Nu's expansion in Europe.

We are looking for a senior AML professional to act as deputy to the Head of AML/CFTP & Sanctions. In 2027 you will take over the day to day MLRO duties of the Swiss entity, so the Head of AML can focus on strategy, and you will help take the framework built in Switzerland to new markets in Europe, adapting it to the new EU AML package (AMLR and AMLD6).

You will join a small, senior team where everyone owns their decisions and does the work themselves. You will work directly with senior management, the first line, our auditors and our regulators.

You'll be responsible for

  • Act as deputy to the AML Compliance Officer (MLRO) and stand in whenever needed

  • Run the day to day MLRO activities: escalated cases, decisions on reports to MROS under Art. 9 AMLA through goAML, and sanctions duties towards SECO, including asset freezes

  • Review and challenge the first line: sample based quality assurance of alert handling and case files, and sign off on changes to transaction monitoring rules and screening thresholds

  • Keep the framework current: entity risk analysis, internal directives and procedures, and the annual AML/CFT report to the Board

  • Issue the financial crime opinion on new products, features and material changes at the Product Risk Committee

  • Be the point of contact for our SRO, MROS, SECO and the external AML auditor, and for due diligence requests from partner and correspondent institutions

  • Own the AML/CFT training plan and the training duty under Art. 8 AMLA

  • As Nu expands in Europe, adapt the Swiss framework to the new EU AML package (AMLR and AMLD6) and turn it into binding control requirements for product, engineering and operations

We are looking for someone who has

  • Served as MLRO, AML Compliance Officer or formal deputy at a regulated financial intermediary in Switzerland, supervised by FINMA or an SRO, or in the EU (mandatory)

  • Lives in Switzerland today (mandatory)

  • Meets the fit and proper requirements that regulators apply to AML officers (mandatory)

  • Holds the CAMS certification (mandatory)

  • Speaks fluent English, our working language, and fluent German (mandatory)

  • Has practical experience with the Swiss AML framework (AMLA, AMLO, FINMA AMLO and SRO rules, MROS and SECO reporting), the EU AML framework, or both, and a working knowledge of the new EU AML package (AMLR and AMLD6)

  • Has built or set up an AML function or framework

  • Has taken and defended reporting and freezing decisions, and has dealt directly with FINMA, SROs, other regulators and external auditors

  • Has reviewed and challenged first line controls at a senior level: transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, KYC and customer risk classification

  • Writes clearly and precisely in policies, opinions and regulatory correspondence

Nice to have

  • Sanctions expertise: screening, list management, asset freezes and reporting under Swiss and EU sanctions regimes

  • Experience with international remittances and cross border payments

  • Travel Rule compliance, including for digital assets

  • Experience in a fintech or in a newly authorised financial institution

  • Comfort using data and AI tools to review alerts, test controls and draft documentation

  • Other certifications such as CGSS, CCAS, Chainalysis Reactor or Chainalysis KYT (recommended)

Location for this opportunity

  • Zug, Switzerland (you must live in Switzerland today)

Our Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank

  • Health Insurance Allowance for you and your dependents

  • Pension Plan

  • Accident Insurance

  • Daily Sickness Benefits

  • Life Insurance & Death Benefits

  • NuCare – Employee Assistance Programme, available 24/7 for you and your dependents

  • NuLanguage – Language Course Program

  • Extended Parental Leave

  • International Travel Insurance for business trips

  • Work-from-home Allowance and office equipment for working from home

  • Parking space at the Zug office

Work Model for this Role

  • Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers.

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here

jobs.title: Homologation & Certification Engineer, Energy Systems
jobs.description:
About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready.

This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland. We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate.

 

Key responsibilities

Certification strategy and project management

  • Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

  • Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work

  • Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT)

Safety engineering and risk analysis

  • Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882)

  • Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing

  • Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection

  • Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports

Compliance and technical documentation

  • Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports

  • Write and review user, installation, operation and maintenance manuals, safety instructions and labelling

  • Maintain the standards register and assess the impact of new or revised standards

  • Manage certification change control: assess design changes for impact on existing certificates

Collaboration and continuous improvement

  • Act as the internal authority on certification scope: ensure in-service conformity of series production with certified designs, and support procurement and supply chain on material and packaging compliance (e.g. RoHS, packaging regulations).

  • Support design reviews and supplier qualification, including component certificates (ATEX, PED, electrical)

Standards and regulatory scope

The role covers, but is not limited to, the frameworks below. Working knowledge of most is expected; deep expertise in several is required

  • IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1:2021, ISO 16110-1 and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230

     

Required qualifications

  • Master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, process or safety engineering, or equivalent

  • 5+ years in product certification, compliance or safety engineering for complex electromechanical or process equipment (energy, gas, process, machinery or marine)

  • Direct experience with hydrogen or fuel cell systems and the IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1 or ISO 16110

  • Proven track record of taking products through CE marking and third-party certification with notified bodies or NRTLs

  • Hands-on experience leading FMEA, HAZOP and risk assessments, and documenting them to auditor standard

  • Solid knowledge of ATEX / IECEx, hazardous area classification and explosion-protection concepts

  • Experience specifying and validating safety functions to ISO 13849 and/or IEC 61508

  • Excellent technical writing: clear, structured, audit-ready technical files and manuals

  • Fluent English, written and spoken

     

Preferred qualifications and personal profile

Nice to have

  • Marine type approval with a classification society (DNV, LR, BV, ABS) or IGF Code projects

  • Experience with fuel processing, reformers or fire equipment, and with pressure equipment under PED

  • Certified functional safety qualification or ATEX/IECEx competence certification

  • Familiarity with North American codes (NEC, NFPA) and UL/CSA certification

Personal profile

  • Rigorous and structured, with a strong safety mindset and an eye for detail

  • Pragmatic: finds compliant solutions that keep development moving

  • Confident communicator with engineers, auditors, authorities and customers

  • Self-driven in a fast-growing, scale-up environment; comfortable owning topics end to end

     

Start date: Immediately

jobs.title: Triage audicien - Drachten, Friesland
jobs.description:
Bouw mee aan hoogwaardige hoorzorg binnen een zelfstandige optiekwinkel

Ben jij audicien en wil je méér dan alleen hoortoestellen aanpassen? Zoek je een plek waar je de tijd krijgt voor je klant, kwaliteit vooropstaat en je tegelijkertijd de ruimte krijgt om mee te bouwen aan een succesvolle audiotak?

Dan is dit misschien wel jouw volgende stap.

Premium hoorzorg, zoals het bedoeld is

Binnen onze zelfstandige optiekwinkels staat persoonlijke aandacht centraal. Onze klanten kennen ons vanwege onze deskundigheid, kwaliteit en service. Diezelfde benadering willen we verder uitbouwen binnen horen.

Daarom zoeken we een audicien die samen met ons wil bouwen aan een sterke audiotak. Afhankelijk van de situatie gaat het om het verder ontwikkelen van een bestaande klantenkring of het opbouwen van een nieuwe activiteit binnen een winkel waar al een vertrouwde klantenbasis aanwezig is.

Je krijgt daarbij de ruimte om je vak uit te oefenen zoals jij vindt dat goede hoorzorg hoort te zijn: met tijd voor de klant, persoonlijke aandacht en premium hooroplossingen.

Wat maakt deze functie anders?

Je werkt in een professionele, persoonlijke omgeving waar niet de snelle verkoop, maar de beste oplossing voor de klant centraal staat.

Je kunt rekenen op:

· Premium hooroplossingen

· Ruim voldoende tijd en aandacht voor iedere klant

· Een bestaand klantenbestand vanuit de optiek

· Warme leads via onze partner Audibene

· Professionele ondersteuning en coaching vanuit de organisatie

· Ruimte voor jouw ideeën en vakmanschap

· De kans om daadwerkelijk mee te bouwen aan de audiotak

· Dagen en uren in overleg, met aandacht voor een gezonde balans tussen werk en privé

Voor wie is dit een mooie stap?

Misschien werk je nu bij een grotere keten en zoek je meer persoonlijke aandacht, vrijheid en betrokkenheid. Of je bent toe aan een omgeving waarin je niet alleen audicien bent, maar ook kunt meedenken over hoe we de beste hoorzorg voor onze klanten organiseren.

Ruime ervaring is voor ons niet het belangrijkste. Veel belangrijker is dat je passie hebt voor horen én voor mensen.

Je bent iemand die kwaliteit belangrijk vindt, graag persoonlijk contact heeft met klanten en energie krijgt van samen iets moois opbouwen. Je wilt onderdeel zijn van een professioneel en kundig team, maar vindt het tegelijkertijd leuk om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen voor je eigen vakgebied.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Een zelfstandige functie met veel ruimte voor vakmanschap en persoonlijke aandacht, maar mét een professioneel team en organisatie achter je.

Geen omgeving waarin iedere minuut wordt gestuurd door targets en agenda’s, maar een plek waar we geloven dat tevreden klanten en goede hoorzorg de basis zijn voor duurzaam succes.

En minstens zo belangrijk: werk moet passen bij je leven. Daarom bespreken we graag samen welke dagen en uren het beste aansluiten. Of je nu een aantal dagen per week wilt werken of juist een volgende stap zoekt met meer verantwoordelijkheid: we kijken vooral naar wat bij elkaar past.

Zin om samen iets moois op te bouwen?

Ben jij audicien en spreekt de combinatie van kwaliteit, persoonlijke aandacht, vrijheid en bouwen je aan?

Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Ook als je nog niet jarenlang ervaring hebt, maar wel gepassioneerd bent over het vak, nodigen we je van harte uit om te reageren.

Earnings at a Glance

  • $15.00–$17.00 per hour, plus performance incentives

  • $300 certification bonus once you complete 200 productive hours

  • +$50 bonus if you certify within 6 weeks

  • Choose your own hours. Coverage runs 24/7, every day

  • Remote, U.S.-based, 1099 independent contractor

The Opportunity

Help cardholders manage their money with confidence. You'll take inbound calls from people who rely on their cards for everyday life. They might be activating a new card, replacing a lost one, sorting out a disputed charge, or getting a time-sensitive payment through. These moments matter, and you're the person who makes them go smoothly.

What the Work Involves

  • Inbound calls on card activation, replacements, lost or stolen cards, balances, and account questions

  • Payments, transfers, and disputes, handled accurately and securely

  • Identity verification and strict security and compliance protocols on every call

  • Spotting potential fraud and helping resolve it with composure

  • Accurate documentation of every interaction

You're a Fit If You Bring

  • Clear, empathetic phone communication, even when callers are stressed

  • Care for protecting sensitive financial information

  • Comfort moving between multiple systems at once

  • Composure and problem-solving in a fast-paced environment

  • Strong plus: banking, card, financial services, or contact center experience

Your Path to Starting Work

  1. Week 1: Apply. Create your ShyftOff account and apply to the Financial Services campaign.

  2. Weeks 2–3: Screening & credentialing. Federal background check, fingerprinting, drug screening, and credential issuance.

  • Fingerprinting

  • Drug screening

  • YubiKey security device (yours to keep)

  • Ability to pass federal background, fingerprint, and drug screening

  • A quiet home workspace and reliable high-speed internet

  • Commitment to completing self-paced certification (about 6 weeks)

How to Apply

  1. Create your agent account at https://www.shyftoff.com/agents

This is an independent contractor (1099) opportunity. You set your own schedule, work remotely, and provide your own workspace and equipment.

jobs.description:
For thousands of years, maps have provided humans with the knowledge they need to make decisions. As a Maps Evaluator, you will have the opportunity to provide ground truth for your town, city or country.

 

At Peroptyx, we are looking for Data Analysts who will review mapping data for digital mapping applications. Your research capabilities will validate and ensure that the navigation of certain routes are accurate and safe.

 

As part of this role you will verify that business names and opening hours are correct. You will check that the distance from a starting point to an end destination is listed accurately, resulting in better user experiences.

 

With this job you can plan your days around this highly flexible working schedule, work weekends or late evenings, all from the comfort of your own office. The flexibility of our roles minimizes the impact on your daily routine.

 

So, whether you are a student looking to earn as you learn, a retiree looking for a new challenge, a part-time/full time professional or a work from home parent, Peroptyx has the right role for you!

  • Avoid the long commute.

  • Work from the comfort of your home office.
